- `label-hint` (string | undefined): Short text shown after the label and read with it as part of the field's name, so people know before submitting whether to answer: "(optional)" on the few optional fields of a mostly required form, or "(required)" the other way round, in the page's own language. It changes no validation; set `required` for that, and keep the two consistent. When NOT to use: do not put instructions or formats in it (use `help-text`), errors (use `error-text`), or a repeat of the label.
- `maxlength` (number | undefined, minimum 0, maximum 2147483647): Native maximum length in UTF-16 code units. The input prevents user entry past this limit. When to use: cap the number of characters people can enter.
- `minlength` (number | undefined, minimum 0, maximum 2147483647): Native minimum length in UTF-16 code units for a nonempty user edit. When to use: require a minimum number of characters in an answer.
- `name` (string | undefined): Form-data key for the submitted value. When NOT to use: omit when the field must not contribute named form data.
- `placeholder` (string | undefined): Hint shown when the field is empty. When NOT to use: do not use placeholder as the accessible name.
- `readonly` (boolean, default false): Makes the value focusable and selectable while rejecting edits. When NOT to use: use `disabled` when the value must be unavailable and excluded from forms.
- `required` (boolean, default false): Marks the field as required for native constraint validation. When NOT to use: do not use required on optional fields.
- `show-count` (boolean | undefined, default false): Shows the current count and maximum next to the help or error text and announces reaching or exceeding the limit. Requires `maxlength`. When to use: give people feedback while writing to a limit.
- `size` ("lg" | "md" | "sm" | "xl" | "xs", default 'md'): Token-backed field size (`--ki-input-{size}-*` tokens): the field box is 24, 32, 40, 48 or 56px tall in onmars, with its padding, radius, text and icon box; the label and help text follow in three steps. An unrecognized value matches no style rule and keeps the medium metrics. When to use: match the size of the buttons and fields around it. When NOT to use: do not pick a smaller size to fit a dense region or a larger one for touch; declare `data-ki-density` on the region instead, which composes with every size.
- `type` ("email" | "password" | "search" | "tel" | "text" | "url", default 'text'): Entry kind with native single-line input semantics. Unknown runtime values fall back to `text`; `number` is not a v1 input kind. When NOT to use: use future numeric controls for locale-aware number entry.
- `value` (string, default ''): Live text value. The attribute declares the initial default; the property is the current value and programmatic assignments are silent. Deviation from native (deliberate, research D2): assigning the ATTRIBUTE programmatically also replaces the displayed value, silently — native inputs would keep the user's dirty value. Form reset restores the attribute's current value. When NOT to use: do not observe user edits by polling; listen for `input` and `change` (both re-dispatched composed across the shadow boundary).

Slots:
- `action`: One small submit action inside the field after the end adornment. Use for one-field forms such as search or subscribe. Place a named `ki-button size="sm" type="submit"` here, or wire a labeled `ki-icon-button size="sm"` to request form submission. The action has its own tab stop. Use the end slot for clear or reveal controls.
- `end`: Trailing icon or text affix inside the field. Follows writing direction. A directly slotted AI label also describes the field as suggested by AI.
- `start`: Leading icon or text affix inside the field. Follows writing direction.

Parts:
- `count`: Current character count and maximum at the end of the field message row.
- `error`: Error line shown in place of the help text while the field is invalid after the person answered or submitted; a polite live region, starting with a decorative error symbol.
- `field`: Enclosure wrapper for background, border, radius and focus ring.
- `help`: Help line under the field, read as the field's description.
- `input`: Internal native input that owns entry text, caret and selection.
- `label`: Visible label that provides the accessible name.
- `label-hint`: The `label-hint` text after the label text, inside the label and part of the accessible name; rendered only while a hint is set.

Events:
- `change` (Event): Fired when the user commits an edited value (native text-field timing, such as on blur), composed across the shadow boundary; `value` is already current when listeners run. When to use: react to a committed value. When NOT to use: do not use it for per-keystroke updates; the native `input` event carries those.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-input-action-gap`: Gap between the input action and the preceding control or adornment.
- `--ki-input-action-padding-end`: Inline-end inset between the input action and the inside edge of the field border.
- `--ki-input-appearance-border-width`: Resting stroke width of both explicit text field appearances.
- `--ki-input-border-block-end-width`: dimension used by the input component for border block end width.
- `--ki-input-border-block-start-width`: dimension used by the input component for border block start width.
- `--ki-input-border-inline-end-width`: dimension used by the input component for border inline end width.
- `--ki-input-border-inline-start-width`: dimension used by the input component for border inline start width.
- `--ki-input-count-bg`: Resting character count surface over the surrounding page.
- `--ki-input-count-fg`: Character count when the value fits the maximum.
- `--ki-input-count-over-bg`: Over-limit character count surface over the surrounding page.
- `--ki-input-count-over-fg`: Character count when the value exceeds the maximum.
- `--ki-input-disabled-bg`: color used by the input component for disabled background.
- `--ki-input-disabled-border`: color used by the input component for disabled border.
- `--ki-input-disabled-fg`: color used by the input component for disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled text Text/base_em; disabled cells are exempt from the contrast sweep).
- `--ki-input-disabled-label-fg`: color used by the input component for disabled label foreground.
- `--ki-input-disabled-placeholder-fg`: color used by the input component for disabled placeholder foreground.
- `--ki-input-filled-backdrop-filter`: Optional backdrop filter of a filled field.
- `--ki-input-filled-bg`: Surface of a filled text field.
- `--ki-input-filled-bg-image`: Optional background image of a filled field.
- `--ki-input-filled-fg`: Entered text on a filled field.
- `--ki-input-filled-focus-width`: Stroke width of the block-end indicator while focused.
- `--ki-input-filled-indicator`: Continuous block-end edge of an enabled filled text field.
- `--ki-input-filled-placeholder-fg`: Placeholder on a filled field.
- `--ki-input-filled-radius`: Block-start corner radius of a filled text field.
- `--ki-input-focus-bg`: color used by the input component for focus background (MarsUI active state switches the fill to Surface/Special white / dark s2 — modeled with the scheme ladder s0).
- `--ki-input-focus-fg`: color used by the input component for focus foreground.
- `--ki-input-focus-label-fg`: color used by the input component for focus label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).
- `--ki-input-focus-placeholder-fg`: color used by the input component for focus placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).
- `--ki-input-focus-ring-color`: color used by the input component for focus ring color.
- `--ki-input-focus-ring-offset`: dimension used by the input component for focus ring offset.
- `--ki-input-focus-ring-shadow`: shadow used by the input component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
- `--ki-input-focus-ring-width`: dimension used by the input component for focus ring width.
- `--ki-input-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for font size.
- `--ki-input-font-size-touch`: dimension used by the input component for the text a person types under a coarse primary pointer: 16px, under which Safari on iOS zooms the page into the focused field (spec 048). The onmars type scale has no 16px step.
- `--ki-input-font-weight`: font weight used by the input component for font weight.
- `--ki-input-gap`: dimension used by the input component for gap.
- `--ki-input-height`: dimension used by the input component for height (MarsUI Input_field md cell: min-height 40px; consume as min-block-size so the field can grow).
- `--ki-input-hover-bg`: color used by the input component for hover background (MarsUI hover = s2 + Black/3 overlay; s3 is the nearest token).
- `--ki-input-hover-border`: color used by the input component for hover border.
- `--ki-input-hover-fg`: color used by the input component for hover foreground.
- `--ki-input-hover-label-fg`: color used by the input component for hover label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).
- `--ki-input-hover-placeholder-fg`: color used by the input component for hover placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).
- `--ki-input-icon-size`: dimension used by the input component for icon size.
- `--ki-input-invalid-bg`: color used by the input component for invalid background (MarsUI danger state keeps the white active fill; the ring and hint carry the signal).
- `--ki-input-invalid-border`: color used by the input component for invalid border.
- `--ki-input-invalid-fg`: color used by the input component for invalid foreground.
- `--ki-input-invalid-label-fg`: color used by the input component for invalid label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).
- `--ki-input-invalid-placeholder-fg`: color used by the input component for invalid placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).
- `--ki-input-invalid-ring`: shadow used by the input component for the persistent invalid ring (MarsUI Focus/danger: 3px danger-500 alpha spread; applied as box-shadow while :state(user-invalid)).
- `--ki-input-label-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for label font size (MarsUI UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).
- `--ki-input-label-font-weight`: font weight used by the input component for label font weight.
- `--ki-input-label-gap`: dimension used by the input component for label gap.
- `--ki-input-label-hint-fg`: color used by the input component for the label hint after the label text (spec 047: the supporting-text role, a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI Input_label support text Text/low_em, which reads 2.8-3.13:1 on the onmars light surfaces; under more contrast it strengthens with every other supporting text).
- `--ki-input-label-hint-gap`: dimension used by the input component for the gap between the label text and the label hint (MarsUI Input_label: Space/xs 4px).
- `--ki-input-label-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for label line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).
- `--ki-input-label-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for label padding inline (MarsUI Input_label row 2px inset aligning the label ink with the cell radius).
- `--ki-input-lg-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for lg font size: body-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 lg).
- `--ki-input-lg-height`: dimension used by the input component for lg height (Input-cell 8016:286 lg: 48px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).
- `--ki-input-lg-icon-size`: dimension used by the input component for the lg icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 lg icon 20px).
- `--ki-input-lg-label-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for the lg label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-lg-label-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for the lg label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-lg-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for lg line height (body-2, Input-cell 8016:286 lg).
- `--ki-input-lg-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for lg padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 lg binds Space/xl, 12px).
- `--ki-input-lg-radius`: dimension used by the input component for lg radius (Input-cell 8016:286 lg binds Radius/small-component/lg).
- `--ki-input-lg-text-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for the lg inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 lg Text_wrap binds Space/xs, 4px; medium uses the gap token).
- `--ki-input-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for line height.
- `--ki-input-outlined-bg`: Surface of an outlined text field.
- `--ki-input-outlined-border`: Full outline of an enabled outlined text field.
- `--ki-input-outlined-fg`: Entered text on an outlined field.
- `--ki-input-outlined-placeholder-fg`: Placeholder on an outlined field.
- `--ki-input-outlined-radius`: Corner radius of an outlined text field.
- `--ki-input-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for padding inline.
- `--ki-input-radius`: dimension used by the input component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_md 10px, the md Input_cell binding; component ramp so personality modes reach it).
- `--ki-input-readonly-bg`: color used by the input component for readonly background (retires the deprecated ki.surface.raised alias; same resolved value).
- `--ki-input-readonly-border`: color used by the input component for readonly border.
- `--ki-input-readonly-fg`: color used by the input component for readonly foreground.
- `--ki-input-readonly-label-fg`: color used by the input component for readonly label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).
- `--ki-input-readonly-placeholder-fg`: color used by the input component for readonly placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).
- `--ki-input-rest-bg`: color used by the input component for rest background (MarsUI Input_field rest fill Surface/s2: the fill identifies the field, not the outline).
- `--ki-input-rest-border`: color used by the input component for rest border.
- `--ki-input-rest-fg`: color used by the input component for rest foreground.
- `--ki-input-rest-label-fg`: color used by the input component for rest label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).
- `--ki-input-rest-placeholder-fg`: color used by the input component for rest placeholder foreground (Text/med_em — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI placeholder binding Text/low_em, which reads 2.66-3.13:1 on the light field fills; a placeholder is not the accessible name but it is still text, so the contrast gate holds it to 4.5:1).
- `--ki-input-sm-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for sm font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 sm).
- `--ki-input-sm-height`: dimension used by the input component for sm height (Input-cell 8016:286 sm: 32px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).
- `--ki-input-sm-icon-size`: dimension used by the input component for the sm icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 sm icon 16px).
- `--ki-input-sm-label-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for the sm label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-sm-label-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for the sm label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-sm-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for sm line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 sm).
- `--ki-input-sm-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for sm padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 sm binds Space/md, 8px).
- `--ki-input-sm-radius`: dimension used by the input component for sm radius (Input-cell 8016:286 sm binds Radius/small-component/sm).
- `--ki-input-sm-text-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for the sm inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 sm Text_wrap binds Space/xs, 4px; medium uses the gap token).
- `--ki-input-xl-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for xl font size: title-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 xl).
- `--ki-input-xl-height`: dimension used by the input component for xl height (Input-cell 8016:286 xl: 56px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).
- `--ki-input-xl-icon-size`: dimension used by the input component for the xl icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 xl icon 24px).
- `--ki-input-xl-label-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for the xl label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-xl-label-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for the xl label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-xl-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for xl line height (title-2, Input-cell 8016:286 xl).
- `--ki-input-xl-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for xl padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 xl binds Space/2xl, 14px).
- `--ki-input-xl-radius`: dimension used by the input component for xl radius (Input-cell 8016:286 xl binds Radius/small-component/xl).
- `--ki-input-xl-text-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for the xl inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 xl Text_wrap binds Space/sm, 6px; medium uses the gap token).
- `--ki-input-xs-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for xs font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 xs). Figma draws caption_1, 10px; caption_2, 12px, is the smallest text the library ships (spec 050 D7).
- `--ki-input-xs-height`: dimension used by the input component for xs height (Input-cell 8016:286 xs: 24px; consumed as min-block-size, spec 050).
- `--ki-input-xs-icon-size`: dimension used by the input component for the xs icon box (Input-cell 8016:286 xs icon 14px).
- `--ki-input-xs-label-font-size`: dimension used by the input component for the xs label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-xs-label-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for the xs label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-input-xs-line-height`: dimension used by the input component for xs line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 xs).
- `--ki-input-xs-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for xs padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 xs binds Space/sm, 6px).
- `--ki-input-xs-radius`: dimension used by the input component for xs radius (Input-cell 8016:286 xs binds Radius/small-component/xs).
- `--ki-input-xs-text-padding-inline`: dimension used by the input component for the xs inline padding of the native control (Input-cell 8016:286 xs Text_wrap binds Space/xxs, 2px; medium uses the gap token).
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-motion-easing-standard`: Standard interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-text-danger-high-em`: semantic color for text danger high em.
- `--ki-text-supporting`: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size`: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-normal`: semantic font weight for typography weight body normal.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold`: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

### ki-link

A native navigation link with Kimen ink, underline, and focus styles.

When to use: navigate to a page, section, or resource. Use a descriptive label and keep the default underline in running text. Leave the action binding unset for native navigation.
When NOT to use: perform an action on the current page. Use ki-button variant="ghost" for that.

Examples:

## Read a related page

```html
<p>Read the <ki-link href="/docs/catalog">catalog contract</ki-link> before adding a component.</p>
```

## Open an external resource

```html
<ki-link href="https://github.com/kimen-dev/kimen" external>Source on GitHub</ki-link>
```

## Link from standalone navigation

```html
<nav aria-label="Resources">
  <ki-link href="/docs" underline="hover">Documentation</ki-link>
  <ki-link href="/changelog" variant="neutral" underline="hover">Changelog</ki-link>
</nav>
```

## Navigate from a guarded surface

Supply `href` and the default text slot. The surface URL policy applies.
Leave the action binding unset for native navigation.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "root": {
    "component": "ki-link",
    "props": { "href": "/docs/catalog" },
    "slots": { "": ["Catalog contract"] }
  }
}
```

Attributes:
- `download` (string | undefined): Native download attribute. Set it to an empty string to let the browser choose the file name, or supply a suggested file name.
- `external` (boolean, default false): Requests a new tab with noopener and adds an icon and an accessible announcement. An explicit download still follows native download rules.
- `external-label` (string, default '(opens in a new tab)'): Localizable text appended to the accessible name in external mode.
- `href` (string, required, URL): Destination URL. Relative URLs and fragments use native anchor resolution.
- `rel` (string | undefined): Space-separated native link relationships. External links always include noopener.
- `target` (string | undefined): Native browsing-context name. External links use _blank.
- `underline` ("always" | "hover", default 'always'): Keep the underline in running text. Use hover for standalone navigation, where placement identifies the link and keyboard focus still underlines it.
- `variant` ("neutral" | "primary", default 'primary'): Ink role. Primary uses accent ink and neutral uses body ink.

Slots:
- (default): Descriptive link text. Use phrasing content without nested interactive controls.

Parts:
- `link`: The native anchor that renders the link and receives focus.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-link-bg`: Transparent backing for primary link text.
- `--ki-link-bg-image`: Optional image overlay for link backing.
- `--ki-link-fg`: Accent ink for primary links.
- `--ki-link-font-family`: Body typeface used by link text.
- `--ki-link-icon-gap`: Space between the label and the external link icon.
- `--ki-link-icon-size`: External link icon edge relative to the inherited text size.
- `--ki-link-neutral-bg`: Transparent backing for neutral link text.
- `--ki-link-neutral-fg`: Body ink for neutral links.
- `--ki-link-radius`: Corner radius used by the link focus outline.
- `--ki-link-underline-offset`: Space between link text and its underline.
- `--ki-link-underline-thickness`: Resting underline thickness.
- `--ki-link-underline-thickness-hover`: Underline thickness under a hover-capable pointer.
- `--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size`: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

### ki-list

A vertical list of read-only entries, navigation links, settings controls, or options in a single- or multiple-selection listbox.

When to use: settings, contacts, results, navigation or visible choices composed
from primary text, supporting text and optional media. Name interactive lists.
When NOT to use: popup action menus, tabular data, or rows with several actions.

Examples:

The list accepts only `ki-list-item` children (other children are unsupported); each item's default slot is the primary text line:

```html
<ki-list>
  <ki-list-item>Ada Lovelace</ki-list-item>
  <ki-list-item>Grace Hopper</ki-list-item>
  <ki-list-item>Margaret Hamilton</ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

Full item composition — `start` for leading media (decorative beside the visible name, so the avatar carries no `label`), `secondary` for supporting text and `end` for trailing meta:

```html
<ki-list>
  <ki-list-item>
    <ki-avatar slot="start" initials="AL" size="sm"></ki-avatar>
    Ada Lovelace
    <span slot="secondary">Analytical engine programs</span>
    <ki-badge slot="end" tone="success">Active</ki-badge>
  </ki-list-item>
  <ki-list-item>
    <ki-avatar slot="start" initials="GH" size="sm"></ki-avatar>
    Grace Hopper
    <span slot="secondary">Compilers and COBOL</span>
    <span slot="end">1906–1992</span>
  </ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

```html
<ki-list label="Settings">
  <ki-list-item href="/settings/account">
    Account
    <span slot="secondary">Name, email, password</span>
  </ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

```html
<ki-list label="Reviewers" selection="multiple" name="reviewers" required>
  <ki-list-item value="ana" selected>Ana Garcia</ki-list-item>
  <ki-list-item value="luis">Luis Perez</ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

```html
<ki-list label="Notifications">
  <ki-list-item>
    Email digest
    <span slot="secondary">Every Monday</span>
    <ki-switch slot="end" checked></ki-switch>
  </ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

Attributes:
- `label` (string | undefined): Accessible name for a list with links, options or trailing controls.
- `name` (string | undefined): Form field name. Multiple selection submits repeated entries under this name.
- `required` (boolean, default false): Requires at least one enabled choice in a selection list.
- `selection` ("multiple" | "none" | "single", default 'none'): Enables single or multiple selection. The default supports static, link and control rows.

Slots:
- (default): Direct `ki-list-item` children.

Parts:
- `list`: List surface that owns background, padding, gap and dividers.

Events:
- `ki-change` (CustomEvent<KiListChangeDetail>): Fires once per user selection change, after updating the form value.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-list-bg`: color used by the list component for background.
- `--ki-list-gap`: dimension used by the list component for gap (MarsUI compositions stack rows contiguously; --ki-list-gap stays as the theme hook).
- `--ki-list-item-divider-color`: color used by the list component for item divider color.
- `--ki-list-item-divider-width`: dimension used by the list component for item divider width (no divider renders in any master variant; the color hook ki.list.item.divider-color stays so consumers can opt hairlines back in).
- `--ki-list-padding`: dimension used by the list component for padding.
- `--ki-motion-distance-xs`: Motion travel distance xs (2px): hover-lift offsets.
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-duration-medium-1`: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-list-item

A row inside `ki-list`, composed from leading media, primary text, optional secondary text and trailing content.

When to use: as a direct child of `ki-list`, for a static entry, link,
selection option, or a settings row with one control.
When NOT to use: as a menu item, tabular row, or row with several actions.

Examples:

Valid only as a child of `ki-list`; the default slot is the primary text line:

```html
<ki-list>
  <ki-list-item>Release 1.4 shipped</ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

`secondary` adds a supporting line below the primary text; its presence selects the multi-line min-height token:

```html
<ki-list>
  <ki-list-item>
    Backups
    <span slot="secondary">Last run 2 hours ago</span>
  </ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

`start` leads with media and `end` trails with meta or a slotted control; media beside the visible primary text is decorative (unlabeled avatar, empty `alt`), while an unlabeled trailing control receives its name from the row:

```html
<ki-list label="Contacts">
  <ki-list-item>
    <ki-avatar slot="start" initials="GH" size="sm"></ki-avatar>
    Grace Hopper
    <span slot="secondary">Compilers and COBOL</span>
    <ki-icon-button slot="end" size="sm" label="Edit Grace Hopper">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 20l1-4L16 5l3 3L8 19l-4 1z" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
    </ki-icon-button>
  </ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

```html
<ki-list label="Settings">
  <ki-list-item href="/settings/account">
    Account
    <span slot="secondary">Name, email, password</span>
  </ki-list-item>
</ki-list>
```

Attributes:
- `disabled` (boolean, default false): Excludes this option from focus, selection by the user, and form data.
- `href` (string | undefined, URL): Native row link destination. Use outside selection lists, with no slotted interactive content.
- `selected` (boolean, default false): Whether this row is selected in a single- or multiple-selection list.
- `size` ("lg" | "md" | "sm" | "xl", default 'md'): Token-backed row size (`--ki-list-item-{size}-*` tokens): minimum height (48, 56, 64 or 72px with a secondary line in onmars), padding, gap and text. Slotted start and end content keeps the size its author gave it. An unrecognized value matches no style rule and keeps the medium metrics. When to use: give every row of one list the same size. When NOT to use: do not pick a smaller size to fit a dense region or a larger one for touch; declare `data-ki-density` on the region instead, which composes with every size.
- `value` (string | undefined): Submitted option value. The primary row text supplies the default.

Slots:
- (default): Primary text line.
- `end`: Trailing media, meta text or the only control of a settings row.
- `secondary`: Supporting text below the primary line. Its presence selects the multi-line min-height token.
- `start`: Leading media such as an icon, avatar or image.

Parts:
- `content`: Text column containing primary and secondary lines.
- `end`: Trailing region wrapper.
- `indicator`: Decorative navigation or selection indicator.
- `item`: Item row surface and layout container.
- `start`: Leading region wrapper.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-inverse-white-alpha-3`: semantic color for inverse white alpha 3.
- `--ki-inverse-white-alpha-6`: semantic color for inverse white alpha 6.
- `--ki-list-item-checkbox-radius`: Corner radius of a multiple-selection indicator.
- `--ki-list-item-checkbox-selected-bg`: Fill of the selected multiple-choice indicator.
- `--ki-list-item-checkbox-selected-fg`: Check mark ink on the selected indicator.
- `--ki-list-item-gap`: dimension used by the list component for item gap (MarsUI md/lg rows: Space/xl 12px between start/content/end regions).
- `--ki-list-item-hover-bg`: Background of an unselected hovered interactive list row.
- `--ki-list-item-hover-fg`: Text and indicator on an unselected hovered interactive list row.
- `--ki-list-item-indicator-border-width`: Stroke around a visual option indicator.
- `--ki-list-item-indicator-size`: Edge of the trailing selection or navigation mark.
- `--ki-list-item-interactive-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for an interactive list row.
- `--ki-list-item-interactive-bg`: Resting fill of an unselected interactive list row.
- `--ki-list-item-interactive-bg-image`: Optional image layered over interactive list row fills.
- `--ki-list-item-interactive-radius`: Corner radius of link and option rows.
- `--ki-list-item-lg-gap`: dimension used by the list component for lg item gap (List 10063:2066 lg binds Space/xl, 12px).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-min-height`: dimension used by the list component for the lg one-line item min height (two List 10063:2066 lg block paddings plus the primary line: 48px).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-min-height-multiline`: dimension used by the list component for the lg two-line item min height (List 10063:2066 lg measures 64px).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-padding-block`: dimension used by the list component for lg item padding block (List 10063:2066 lg binds Space/xl, 12px).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-padding-inline`: dimension used by the list component for lg item padding inline (List 10063:2066 lg binds Space/md, 8px).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-primary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for lg primary font size (List 10063:2066 lg primary: UI/body-2).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-primary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for lg primary line height (List 10063:2066 lg).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-secondary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for lg secondary font size (List 10063:2066 lg description: UI/caption-2).
- `--ki-list-item-lg-secondary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for lg secondary line height (List 10063:2066 lg).
- `--ki-list-item-min-height`: dimension used by the list component for item min height (MarsUI md text-only row is ~40px content-sized: 20px line + 2x10 padding).
- `--ki-list-item-min-height-multiline`: dimension used by the list component for multiline item min height (MarsUI md two-line row measures 56px).
- `--ki-list-item-padding-block`: dimension used by the list component for item padding block (MarsUI md rows: Space/lg 10px).
- `--ki-list-item-padding-inline`: dimension used by the list component for item padding inline.
- `--ki-list-item-primary-fg`: color used by the list component for item primary foreground.
- `--ki-list-item-primary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for item primary font size.
- `--ki-list-item-primary-font-weight`: font weight used by the list component for item primary font weight.
- `--ki-list-item-primary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for primary line height (MarsUI primary is UI/Para/medium 13/20, not UI/Body 1 13/24).
- `--ki-list-item-radio-radius`: Corner radius of a single-selection indicator.
- `--ki-list-item-radius`: dimension used by the list component for item radius.
- `--ki-list-item-secondary-fg`: color used by the list component for item secondary foreground.
- `--ki-list-item-secondary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for secondary font size (MarsUI description line is UI/Caption 2: 12px).
- `--ki-list-item-secondary-font-weight`: font weight used by the list component for item secondary font weight.
- `--ki-list-item-secondary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for secondary line height (MarsUI caption_2 16px; same value as before with the correct provenance).
- `--ki-list-item-selected-bg`: Background of a selected list option.
- `--ki-list-item-selected-fg`: Text and indicator on a selected list option.
- `--ki-list-item-sm-gap`: dimension used by the list component for sm item gap (List 10063:2066 sm binds Space/lg, 10px).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-min-height`: dimension used by the list component for the sm one-line item min height (two List 10063:2066 sm block paddings plus the primary line: 32px).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-min-height-multiline`: dimension used by the list component for the sm two-line item min height (List 10063:2066 sm measures 48px).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-padding-block`: dimension used by the list component for sm item padding block (List 10063:2066 sm binds Space/sm, 6px).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-padding-inline`: dimension used by the list component for sm item padding inline (List 10063:2066 sm binds Space/md, 8px).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-primary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for sm primary font size (List 10063:2066 sm primary: UI/para).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-primary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for sm primary line height (List 10063:2066 sm).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-secondary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for sm secondary font size (List 10063:2066 sm description: UI/caption-2).
- `--ki-list-item-sm-secondary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for sm secondary line height (List 10063:2066 sm).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-gap`: dimension used by the list component for xl item gap (List 10063:2066 xl binds Space/3xl, 16px).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-min-height`: dimension used by the list component for the xl one-line item min height (two List 10063:2066 xl block paddings plus the primary line: 52px).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-min-height-multiline`: dimension used by the list component for the xl two-line item min height (List 10063:2066 xl measures 72px).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-padding-block`: dimension used by the list component for xl item padding block (List 10063:2066 xl binds Space/2xl, 14px).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-padding-inline`: dimension used by the list component for xl item padding inline (List 10063:2066 xl binds Space/xl, 12px).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-primary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for xl primary font size (List 10063:2066 xl primary: UI/title-2).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-primary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for xl primary line height (List 10063:2066 xl).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-secondary-font-size`: dimension used by the list component for xl secondary font size (List 10063:2066 xl description: UI/para).
- `--ki-list-item-xl-secondary-line-height`: dimension used by the list component for xl secondary line height (List 10063:2066 xl).
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-markdown

Displays Markdown as Kimen components and native HTML semantics.

When to use: Show a formatted reply, readme excerpt or progressively received text from a person or model.
When NOT to use: Present an editable document or apply trusted authored HTML. Use native markup for structured page content.

Examples:

# ki-markdown examples

The supported Markdown subset includes headings, paragraphs, emphasis,
strikethrough, inline and fenced code, links, opt-in images, ordered and
unordered lists, task items, blockquotes, tables and hard breaks.
Use `> [!NOTE]` to display a Kimen Note.

The package loader registers Markdown, Link, CodeBlock and Note. Register the
child elements your content uses when using direct imports or framework
wrappers.

```js
import { defineCustomElement as defineCodeBlock } from '@kimen/elements/ki-code-block';
import { defineCustomElement as defineLink } from '@kimen/elements/ki-link';
import { defineCustomElement as defineNote } from '@kimen/elements/ki-note';
import { defineCustomElement as defineMarkdown } from '@kimen/elements/ki-markdown';

defineCodeBlock();
defineLink();
defineNote();
defineMarkdown();
```

With a framework wrapper, use the first three registrations. The wrapper
registers Markdown.

Render a short note as static text.

```html
<ki-markdown src-text="## Release notes"></ki-markdown>

<ki-markdown>Check the **release date** and the [upgrade guide](/guides/upgrade).</ki-markdown>
```

Update the source while chunks arrive. When all text has arrived, finish the
stream so the component renders the complete Markdown document.

```html
<ki-markdown id="answer" streaming></ki-markdown>
```

```js
const answer = document.querySelector('#answer');
let source = '';
for await (const chunk of answerChunks) {
  source += chunk;
  answer.srcText = source;
}
answer.streaming = false;
```

Assign untrusted strings to `srcText`. In a static HTML example, escape angle
brackets before passing them as text.

```html
<ki-markdown>&lt;aside&gt;This markup is shown as text.&lt;/aside&gt;</ki-markdown>
```

A guarded surface can pass the source as a string in the default slot.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "root": {
    "component": "ki-markdown",
    "props": { "heading-offset": 1 },
    "slots": { "": ["# Release notes\n\nRead the [upgrade guide](/guides/upgrade)."] }
  }
}
```

Attributes:
- `allow-images` (boolean, default false): Render Markdown images that pass the URL policy. Otherwise show their alternative text.
- `heading-offset` (number, default 2, minimum 0, maximum 5): Add zero through five levels to source headings. The output stops at level six. Invalid values use two.
- `src-text` (string | undefined): Markdown source. A supplied value, including an empty string, takes precedence over the default text slot.
- `streaming` (boolean, default false): Keep established blocks mounted while an answer grows. Turn it off when the source is complete.

Slots:
- (default): Literal Markdown source. Set a text node or escape markup when writing HTML.

Parts:
- `content`: Box containing the formatted blocks.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-corner-inline`: Small radius for an outline around inline content.
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-5xl`: The 5xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xs`: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-markdown-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for the answer surface.
- `--ki-markdown-bg`: Answer surface backing. It defaults to transparent so the enclosing surface shows through.
- `--ki-markdown-bg-image`: Optional image over the answer's solid backing.
- `--ki-markdown-block-gap`: Spacing between Markdown blocks at standard density.
- `--ki-markdown-fg`: Ink for prose and headings.
- `--ki-markdown-heading-family`: Typeface for Markdown headings.
- `--ki-markdown-inline-code-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for inline code.
- `--ki-markdown-inline-code-bg`: Solid backing of an inline code span.
- `--ki-markdown-inline-code-bg-image`: Optional image over the inline code backing.
- `--ki-markdown-inline-code-fg`: Ink for source within an inline code span.
- `--ki-markdown-muted-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for quotes and table headings.
- `--ki-markdown-muted-bg`: Backing of quotes and table headings.
- `--ki-markdown-muted-bg-image`: Optional image over the muted backing.
- `--ki-markdown-muted-fg`: Ink for quotes and table headings, strengthened under more contrast.
- `--ki-markdown-quote-border`: Logical start rule of a quotation and the ink of a thematic divider.
- `--ki-outline-low-em`: semantic color for outline low em.
- `--ki-spacing-action-hairline`: Width of the frame and divider in an action surface.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-family-mono`: semantic font family for typography family mono.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-heading-1`: semantic dimension for typography line height heading 1.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-heading-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height heading 2.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-title-1`: semantic dimension for typography line height title 1.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-title-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height title 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-heading-1`: semantic dimension for typography size heading 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-heading-2`: semantic dimension for typography size heading 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-title-1`: semantic dimension for typography size title 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-title-2`: semantic dimension for typography size title 2.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-medium`: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold`: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

### ki-menu

A popup of actions opened by a button in the same document or shadow root.

When to use: row actions, account commands, split buttons, and overflow actions.
When NOT to use: form values, navigation destinations, or long action lists.

Examples:

# Menu examples

## Row actions

Register `ki-button`, `ki-menu`, `ki-menu-item`, `ki-menu-group`, and
`ki-divider` when using the elements individually.

```html
<ki-button id="row-actions" type="button">Actions</ki-button>
<ki-menu id="row-menu" anchor="row-actions" filter-label="Filter actions">
  <ki-menu-group label="Edit">
    <ki-menu-item value="rename" shortcut="F2">Rename</ki-menu-item>
    <ki-menu-item value="duplicate">Duplicate</ki-menu-item>
    <ki-menu-item value="move" disabled>Move to…</ki-menu-item>
    <ki-menu-item value="pin" type="checkbox" checked>Pin to sidebar</ki-menu-item>
  </ki-menu-group>
  <ki-divider></ki-divider>
  <ki-menu-item value="delete" tone="danger">Delete</ki-menu-item>
</ki-menu>
```

```js
const menu = document.getElementById('row-menu');
menu.addEventListener('ki-select', ({ detail: { value, checked } }) => {
  dispatchRowAction(value, checked);
});
```

A plain action emits its value and closes the popup. A checkbox also emits its
new checked state and keeps the popup open. A radio selection emits
`checked: true`, clears its peer radios and closes the popup. Place independent
radio sets in distinct groups.

## Account menu

```html
<button id="account" type="button" aria-label="Account for Ana García">AG</button>
<ki-menu anchor="account" placement="bottom-end">
  <p slot="header">Ana García<br />ana@example.com</p>
  <ki-divider></ki-divider>
  <ki-menu-item value="profile">Profile</ki-menu-item>
  <ki-menu-item value="sign-out">Sign out</ki-menu-item>
</ki-menu>
```

Give a glyph-only trigger an accessible name. Keep header content informational
and put actions in `ki-menu-item`. A `start` slot can hold a decorative SVG or
avatar. The application owns the shortcuts displayed by `shortcut`.

With a filter, supply `filter-label` and optionally localize
`filter-results-label`, retaining `{count}` where the number should appear.

# When to use Menu

Use Menu for commands on the same object, account actions, split buttons and
overflow actions. Keep destructive actions at the end after a divider. Pick
a select for a form value, links for navigation, or a dialog or page for
long action lists.

Supply a host-authored trigger with an ID in the same DOM tree. Bind the
catalog action on the menu's declared `ki-select` event. Application DOM
listeners can read the selected item's `value` and optional `checked` from
the event detail.

Attributes:
- `anchor` (string, default '', ID of another element of the same spec): Literal ID of the menu button in the same document or containing shadow root.
- `filter-label` (string, default ''): Accessible name and placeholder of the filter. Omit to hide the field.
- `filter-results-label` (string, default 'Matching actions: {count}'): Polite results message. The menu substitutes the number of matches for `{count}`.
- `open` (boolean, default false): Whether the popup is open. Reflected when the user opens or dismisses it.
- `placement` ("bottom-end" | "bottom-start" | "top-end" | "top-start", default 'bottom-start'): Preferred side and logical alignment. Flips when the opposite side has more room.

Slots:
- (default): Place ki-menu-item, ki-menu-group, and ki-divider here.
- `header`: Informational content above the actions, such as account details.

Parts:
- `filter`: The filter field.
- `header`: The informational header.
- `menu`: The named menu containing the actions.
- `popup`: The anchored surface.

Events:
- `ki-select` (CustomEvent<KiMenuSelectDetail>): Reports the selected action and, for a checkbox or radio, its new checked state.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-menu-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter applied to the popup.
- `--ki-menu-bg`: Base fill of the popup surface.
- `--ki-menu-bg-image`: Optional image composited over the popup fill.
- `--ki-menu-border`: Popup edge and the filter divider.
- `--ki-menu-border-width`: Thickness of menu border and dividers.
- `--ki-menu-fg`: Text over the popup surface.
- `--ki-menu-filter-icon-size`: Size of the search icon.
- `--ki-menu-focus-color`: Color of a visible keyboard focus outline.
- `--ki-menu-focus-width`: Width of a visible keyboard focus outline.
- `--ki-menu-font-family`: Family for action labels and the filter.
- `--ki-menu-font-size`: Text size for action labels and the filter.
- `--ki-menu-gap`: Inline space between the parts of a row.
- `--ki-menu-inline-padding`: Start and end inset of an action, group label, or filter.
- `--ki-menu-item-height`: Default action row minimum height.
- `--ki-menu-item-radius`: Action row corner radius.
- `--ki-menu-line-height`: Line height for action labels and the filter.
- `--ki-menu-max-block-size`: Maximum popup height, bounded by the viewport.
- `--ki-menu-max-inline-size`: Maximum popup width, bounded by the viewport.
- `--ki-menu-meta-fg`: Foreground for shortcut hints and the filter placeholder.
- `--ki-menu-min-inline-size`: Default minimum popup width, bounded by the viewport.
- `--ki-menu-padding`: Space inside the popup.
- `--ki-menu-radius`: Popup corner radius.
- `--ki-menu-shadow`: Popup elevation shadow.
- `--ki-menu-touch-target`: Minimum action and filter height for coarse pointers.

### ki-menu-group

A named group of related actions in a ki-menu.

When to use: name a set of related actions or scope exclusive radio items in a menu.
When NOT to use: standalone sections or nested menus.

Examples:

# Menu group

Provide a group label and place menu items or dividers in its default slot. A group scopes its own exclusive radio selection.

```html
<ki-menu anchor="actions">
  <ki-menu-group label="Edit"><ki-menu-item value="rename">Rename</ki-menu-item></ki-menu-group>
</ki-menu>
```

Attributes:
- `label` (string, default ''): Visible and accessible group name.

Slots:
- (default): The ki-menu-item and ki-divider children of the group.

Parts:
- `label`: The visible group name.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-menu-font-family`: Family for action labels and the filter.
- `--ki-menu-group-fg`: Foreground for group labels.
- `--ki-menu-group-label-weight`: Weight of group labels.
- `--ki-menu-inline-padding`: Start and end inset of an action, group label, or filter.
- `--ki-menu-meta-font-size`: Size of metadata and group labels.
- `--ki-menu-meta-line-height`: Line height of metadata and group labels.
- `--ki-menu-padding`: Space inside the popup.

### ki-menu-item

A pointer and keyboard action within a ki-menu.

When to use: a command, independent checkbox action, or exclusive radio action in a menu.
When NOT to use: standalone controls, navigational links, or form options.

Examples:

# Menu item

Give each item a value and a visible label. Use `type="checkbox"` for independent toggles or `type="radio"` for exclusive choices. Set `disabled` to keep an unavailable action discoverable by keyboard.

```html
<ki-menu anchor="actions">
  <ki-menu-item value="pin" type="checkbox" checked>Pin to sidebar</ki-menu-item>
</ki-menu>
```

Attributes:
- `checked` (boolean, default false): Checked state for checkbox and radio actions.
- `disabled` (boolean, default false): Disabled actions remain discoverable via menu navigation.
- `shortcut` (string, default ''): Display-only keyboard shortcut. Applications own shortcut registration.
- `tone` ("danger" | "neutral", default 'neutral'): Apply the danger tone to a destructive action.
- `type` ("checkbox" | "item" | "radio", default 'item'): Action role. A checkbox stays open. A radio selects one action within its group.
- `value` (string, default ''): Action identifier reported by the parent menu.

Slots:
- (default): The action's visible label.
- `start`: One decorative icon or avatar before the label.

Parts:
- `check`: The indicator of a checked action.
- `item`: The focusable action row.
- `shortcut`: The display-only shortcut hint.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-menu-focus-color`: Color of a visible keyboard focus outline.
- `--ki-menu-focus-width`: Width of a visible keyboard focus outline.
- `--ki-menu-font-family`: Family for action labels and the filter.
- `--ki-menu-gap`: Inline space between the parts of a row.
- `--ki-menu-inline-padding`: Start and end inset of an action, group label, or filter.
- `--ki-menu-item-danger-fg`: Foreground for destructive actions.
- `--ki-menu-item-danger-hover-fg`: Foreground for hovered or keyboard-focused destructive actions.
- `--ki-menu-item-disabled-fg`: Muted ink of disabled actions.
- `--ki-menu-item-fg`: Foreground for resting actions.
- `--ki-menu-item-height`: Default action row minimum height.
- `--ki-menu-item-hover-bg`: Background behind hovered or keyboard-focused actions.
- `--ki-menu-item-hover-fg`: Foreground for hovered or keyboard-focused actions.
- `--ki-menu-item-icon-size`: Size of an action glyph and the check indicator.
- `--ki-menu-item-padding`: Vertical inset used when an action wraps.
- `--ki-menu-item-radius`: Action row corner radius.
- `--ki-menu-meta-fg`: Foreground for shortcut hints and the filter placeholder.
- `--ki-menu-meta-font-size`: Size of metadata and group labels.
- `--ki-menu-meta-hover-fg`: Foreground for shortcut hints on a hovered or focused action.
- `--ki-menu-touch-target`: Minimum action and filter height for coarse pointers.

### ki-message

A user message, assistant reply or event.

When to use: Display an entry in ki-conversation.
When NOT to use: Prompt input, page alerts or tool execution.

Examples:

# ki-message examples

## User and event messages

```html
<ki-message message-role="user">Can I export my settings?</ki-message>
<ki-message message-role="event" icon-name="search">Found the export guide</ki-message>
```

## Assistant reply with an avatar and action

The `author` prop names the article. Put formatted content in the default
slot and application controls in `actions`.

```html
<ki-message message-role="assistant" author="Ava said">
  <ki-avatar slot="avatar" size="xs" initials="AV"></ki-avatar>
  <strong>Yes.</strong> Choose <code>JSON</code> from the export menu.
  <details slot="actions">
    <summary>View source</summary>
    Settings export guide
  </details>
</ki-message>
```

## Streaming reply

Add `streaming` while the content is arriving, then remove it when the
complete reply is available. Use a registered Markdown component in the
default slot when your application displays formatted Markdown.

```html
<ki-message message-role="assistant" streaming>Choose the export format</ki-message>
```

## Alternative replies

```html
<ki-message branch-index="2" branch-count="3">Choose JSON for a readable copy.</ki-message>
```

Handle `ki-branch-change` to show the requested alternative. Set
`branchIndex` to `event.detail.index` when replacing the reply content.
Set `actions-label` when the reply supplies a toolbar. The Conversation
guide includes the complete Message actions recipe.

Attributes:
- `actions-label` (string | undefined): Names and enables the assistant toolbar.
- `author` (string | undefined): Accessible article name. Defaults by role.
- `branch-count` (number | undefined, default 1): Total replies. Shows a picker for two or more.
- `branch-index` (number | undefined, default 1): One-based reply index. Update after accepting a branch request.
- `branch-status-label` (string | undefined, default 'Response {index} of {count}'): Branch announcement template with {index} and {count}.
- `feedback` ("bad" | "good" | undefined): Good or bad rating. Restore it when switching branches.
- `icon-name` (string | undefined): Decorative event icon. Search is built in. Import other icons before use.
- `message-role` ("assistant" | "event" | "user" | undefined): Trailing user bubble, leading assistant avatar or centered event.
- `next-branch-label` (string | undefined, default 'Next response'): Next branch button label.
- `previous-branch-label` (string | undefined, default 'Previous response'): Previous branch button label.
- `streaming` (boolean, default false): Show a caret and mark the article busy.

Slots:
- (default): Text or formatted content.
- `actions`: App controls. With actions-label, use direct buttons or a layout-only ki-button-group. Mark regenerate and rating buttons with data-message-action.
- `avatar`: Overrides the decorative assistant avatar.

Parts:
- `actions`: Follow-up controls.
- `avatar`: Assistant avatar.
- `branches`: Branch picker and position.
- `caret`: Decorative streaming marker.
- `content`: Body and optional event icon.
- `message`: Named article.

Events:
- `ki-branch-change` (CustomEvent<{ index: number }>): Requests a branch by its one-based index.
- `ki-feedback` (CustomEvent<{ value: KiMessageFeedback }>): Reports the selected rating.
- `ki-regenerate` (CustomEvent<void>): Requests a new reply on Regenerate.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-disabled-bg`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral disabled background.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-disabled-border`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral disabled border.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-disabled-fg`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral disabled foreground.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-bg`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover background.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-border`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover border.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-hover-fg`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral hover foreground.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-bg`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest background.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-border`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest border.
- `--ki-button-ghost-neutral-rest-fg`: color used by the button component for ghost neutral rest foreground.
- `--ki-button-xs-radius`: dimension used by the button component for xs radius (Button master 8003:300 binds Radius/small-component/xs, the scale a radius mode reassigns).
- `--ki-control-border-width`: Stroke width of the boundary of a compact control.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-icon-button-xs-icon-size`: dimension used by the icon button component for xs icon size (MarsUI Icon/Placeholder_xs 16px — one step above the button xs icon).
- `--ki-icon-button-xs-size`: dimension used by the icon button component for xs box (24px square, Figma Space/7xl).
- `--ki-layout-conversation-avatar-radius`: Round corner radius of the fallback assistant avatar.
- `--ki-layout-conversation-bubble-end-radius`: Smaller radius of the end corner of a user bubble.
- `--ki-layout-conversation-caret-block-size`: Block size of a streaming caret.
- `--ki-layout-conversation-caret-inline-size`: Inline size of a streaming caret.
- `--ki-layout-conversation-user-max-width`: Maximum width of a user bubble relative to the transcript.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-2xl`: The 2xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-3xl`: The 3xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-9xl`: The 9xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-md`: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xl`: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xxs`: The xxs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-message-assistant-fg`: Text ink of an assistant reply on the page surface.
- `--ki-message-avatar-backdrop-filter`: Complete filter behind the default assistant avatar.
- `--ki-message-avatar-bg`: Solid primary container of the default assistant avatar.
- `--ki-message-avatar-bg-image`: Optional image over the default assistant avatar background.
- `--ki-message-avatar-fg`: Glyph ink inside the default assistant avatar.
- `--ki-message-event-fg`: Text and icon ink of a system event on the page surface.
- `--ki-message-padding`: Block and inline padding inside a user bubble, in that order.
- `--ki-message-radius`: Radius of the user bubble corners.
- `--ki-message-user-backdrop-filter`: Complete filter behind the user bubble.
- `--ki-message-user-bg`: Solid background of a user bubble.
- `--ki-message-user-bg-image`: Optional image over the user bubble background.
- `--ki-message-user-fg`: Text ink in a user bubble.
- `--ki-motion-duration-activity-pulse`: Period of an indeterminate typing pulse.
- `--ki-motion-easing-activity-pulse`: Symmetric easing for fluctuations in a typing pulse.
- `--ki-outline-low-em`: semantic color for outline low em.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

### ki-mobile-nav

A fixed or floating navigation bar for the main destinations of a phone layout.

When to use: Place after the main content of a narrow layout. Supply three to five direct ki-mobile-nav-item children and mark the current page on its item. The host reserves room for the bar in normal flow.
When NOT to use: Use buttons for actions. Use TopNav or Sidebar on wide layouts or when there are more than five destinations.

Examples:

# Using ki-mobile-nav

Use one bottom navigation bar for the three to five top-level destinations in
the phone layout. Place it after the content. The host reserves space in the
app shell so the last content can scroll above the links.

```js
import '@kimen/elements/icons/house';
import '@kimen/elements/icons/search';
import '@kimen/elements/icons/inbox';
```

```html
<main>
  <!-- App content -->
</main>
<ki-mobile-nav label="Main" variant="floating">
  <ki-mobile-nav-item href="/" icon-name="house" current>Home</ki-mobile-nav-item>
  <ki-mobile-nav-item href="/search" icon-name="search">Search</ki-mobile-nav-item>
  <ki-mobile-nav-item href="/inbox" icon-name="inbox" count="3">Inbox</ki-mobile-nav-item>
</ki-mobile-nav>
```

Omit `variant` for an edge-to-edge bar. When switching to TopNav or Sidebar,
use one app breakpoint to hide this bar and show the wider navigation.

Attributes:
- `label` (string, default 'Main'): Accessible name of the landmark. Supply a distinct name when the page has more than one navigation landmark.
- `variant` ("fixed" | "floating", default 'fixed'): Place the bar edge to edge or inset it as a raised pill.

Slots:
- (default): Three to five direct ki-mobile-nav-item destinations.

Parts:
- `bar`: The native navigation landmark and painted bar.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-mobile-nav-backdrop-filter`: Complete optional backdrop filter for either bar variant.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-bg`: Fixed bar surface.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-bg-image`: Optional decorative image for either bar variant.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-border`: Stroke along the fixed bar or around the floating bar.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-border-width`: Bar border width.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-floating-bg`: Floating bar surface.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-floating-inset`: Space beside and below the floating bar.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-floating-padding`: Inline padding inside the floating bar.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-floating-radius`: Floating bar pill shape.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-floating-shadow`: Elevation of the floating bar.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-font-family`: Typeface for the bar and its destination labels.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-height`: Minimum height before the safe area and border are added.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-target-min`: Minimum block and inline link target size.

### ki-mobile-nav-item

An icon and visible label for one mobile navigation destination.

When to use: Place directly in ki-mobile-nav. Register a decorative icon and supply a short visible text label. Leave the catalog click action unset for native navigation.
When NOT to use: For a command on the current page, use a button. For inline navigation outside a bottom bar, use ki-link.

Examples:

# Using ki-mobile-nav-item

Use a short label, a registered icon and a destination URL for each native
link inside `ki-mobile-nav`.

```html
<ki-mobile-nav-item href="/" icon-name="house" current>Home</ki-mobile-nav-item>
<ki-mobile-nav-item href="/inbox" icon-name="inbox" count="125" count-label="{count} unread">
  Inbox
</ki-mobile-nav-item>
```

Mark the active destination with `current`. The second link shows `99+` in the
badge and is announced as “Inbox, 125 unread”. A zero count hides the badge.

Attributes:
- `count` (number | undefined): Optional count of new items. Only finite counts of at least one are shown. The painted count is abbreviated above 99.
- `count-label` (string, default '{count} new'): Localized suffix for the link name. Use {count} for the full rounded count.
- `current` (boolean, default false): Marks this link as the current page.
- `href` (string, required, URL): Destination URL. Relative paths and fragments use native anchor resolution.
- `icon-name` (string, required): Registered icon name. The visible destination text supplies the link name.

Slots:
- (default): Visible destination text. Use plain text or noninteractive phrasing content.

Parts:
- `indicator`: The icon well painted on the current destination.
- `label`: The always-visible destination label.
- `link`: The native anchor and focus target.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-border-width`: Bar border width.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-font-family`: Typeface for the bar and its destination labels.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-indicator-bg`: Fill behind the current destination icon.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-indicator-block-size`: Current icon pill height.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-indicator-fg`: Icon ink on the current destination fill.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-indicator-inline-size`: Current icon pill width.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-indicator-radius`: Current icon pill corner radius.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-current-fg`: Label ink of the current destination on the fixed or floating bar.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-fg`: Foreground ink of an inactive destination on the fixed or floating bar.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-focus-radius`: Corner radius of the keyboard focus indication.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-font-size`: Destination label font size.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-font-weight`: Destination label font weight.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-gap`: Gap between the glyph and its label.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-icon-size`: Destination glyph size.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-line-height`: Destination label line height.
- `--ki-mobile-nav-item-target-min`: Minimum block and inline link target size.
- `--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size`: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

### ki-note

A compact, static explanation beside a control or inside a card.

When to use: Add a short constraint, tip or consequence next to the content
it explains. Put the consequence first when warning the reader.
When NOT to use: For updates that must be announced, use ki-alert. Use Toast
for transient confirmations and the field's help-text for field guidance.

Examples:

# ki-note usage

Place one or two lines of static context beside a control or inside a card.
Use `ki-alert` for results that need announcing, Toast for transient
confirmations and the field's `help-text` for field guidance.

```html
<ki-note>Only workspace owners can change billing details.</ki-note>
<ki-note tone="warning" size="sm">Changing the slug breaks existing links.</ki-note>
<ki-note tone="info" icon="false">This link is visible to everyone in the workspace.</ki-note>
```

## Decorative icon replacement

```html
<ki-note tone="info">
  <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
    <path d="M12 3v18M3 12h18"></path>
  </svg>
  Adding a billing contact gives them access to invoices.
</ki-note>
```

The words convey the message by themselves. The decorative icon is hidden
from assistive technology and adds no tab stop. Start warnings with the
consequence.

Attributes:
- `icon` (boolean, default true): Shows the decorative icon. Set icon="false" in HTML to hide it.
- `size` ("md" | "sm", default 'md'): Uses caption text at sm and body text at md. Unknown values use md.
- `tone` ("danger" | "info" | "neutral" | "primary" | "success" | "warning", default 'neutral'): Selects the background tint and decorative icon. Unknown values use neutral.

Slots:
- (default): Short explanatory text that carries the full meaning.
- `icon`: A decorative glyph that replaces the tone's built-in icon.

Parts:
- `icon`: The decorative icon frame.
- `message`: The explanatory text.
- `note`: The surface, including the tint, typography and spacing.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-note-backdrop-filter`: Complete filter behind the note.
- `--ki-note-bg`: Background of a neutral note.
- `--ki-note-bg-image`: Optional image over the note's solid background.
- `--ki-note-danger-bg`: Background of a danger note.
- `--ki-note-danger-fg`: Text ink of a danger note.
- `--ki-note-danger-icon`: Decorative icon ink of a danger note.
- `--ki-note-fg`: Text ink of a neutral note.
- `--ki-note-font-family`: Note text font family.
- `--ki-note-font-size`: Medium note text size.
- `--ki-note-gap`: Space between the icon and the text.
- `--ki-note-icon`: Decorative icon ink of a neutral note.
- `--ki-note-icon-offset`: Medium icon offset from the first line's block start.
- `--ki-note-icon-size`: Medium note icon size.
- `--ki-note-info-bg`: Background of an info note.
- `--ki-note-info-fg`: Text ink of an info note.
- `--ki-note-info-icon`: Decorative icon ink of an info note.
- `--ki-note-line-height`: Medium note text line height.
- `--ki-note-padding-block`: Medium note block padding.
- `--ki-note-padding-inline`: Medium note inline padding.
- `--ki-note-primary-bg`: Background of a primary note.
- `--ki-note-primary-fg`: Text ink of a primary note.
- `--ki-note-primary-icon`: Decorative icon ink of a primary note.
- `--ki-note-radius`: Note surface corner radius.
- `--ki-note-sm-font-size`: Small note caption size.
- `--ki-note-sm-icon-offset`: Small icon offset from the first line's block start.
- `--ki-note-sm-icon-size`: Small note icon size.
- `--ki-note-sm-line-height`: Small note caption line height.
- `--ki-note-sm-padding-block`: Small note block padding.
- `--ki-note-sm-padding-inline`: Small note inline padding.
- `--ki-note-success-bg`: Background of a success note.
- `--ki-note-success-fg`: Text ink of a success note.
- `--ki-note-success-icon`: Decorative icon ink of a success note.
- `--ki-note-warning-bg`: Background of a warning note.
- `--ki-note-warning-fg`: Text ink of a warning note.
- `--ki-note-warning-icon`: Decorative icon ink of a warning note.

### ki-number-input

A form field for a numeric quantity with optional stepper buttons, bounds, locale-aware formatting, and a visible unit.

When to use: Collect a number like a quantity, amount, or limit. Provide a
visible label and choose bounds and an increment when they have meaning.
When NOT to use: Use ki-input for identifiers, codes, or other text that only
looks numeric. Use a range control when relative position is the main cue.

Examples:

# ki-number-input examples

## Quantity with bounds

```html
<ki-number-input label="Seats" name="seats" value="3" min="1" max="50" steppers required></ki-number-input>
```

## Plain field with a unit

```html
<ki-number-input label="Timeout" name="timeout" value="30" unit="seconds" min="0"></ki-number-input>
```

The form submits `timeout=30`.

## Percentage with localized editing

```html
<ki-number-input
  lang="de-DE"
  label="Discount"
  name="discount"
  min="0"
  max="1"
  step="0.005"
  value="0.125"
  format='{"style":"percent","maximumFractionDigits":1}'
></ki-number-input>
```

The editor displays `12,5` while focused and formats it as a percentage on
blur. The form submits `discount=0.125`.

## Text that is not a number

The field keeps text it cannot read as a number so the person can correct
it, shows its own message (`error-text`, else `invalid-number-message`) once
the person leaves the field or presses Enter, and stays invalid, so its form
cannot submit it. What it reports depends on what it held before:

- If it held a number, leaving the field fires one `change` and `value` is
  `undefined`, exactly as when the field is emptied.
- If it never held a number, it fires no `change`.

The event cannot tell an emptied field from an unreadable one; validity can:
`checkValidity()` answers `false` for unreadable text.

## An error from the application
