A bounded scroll container that clips its content along one declared axis and replaces platform scrollbar chrome with a token-resolved indicator.

When to use: a bounded region inside a view whose content can outgrow it:
chat or message panes, code and log blocks, tag rows, sidebar navigation,
tall menus inside cards. Give it bounds (its size comes entirely from your
layout) and a `label` (required: the accessible name of the scroll
region). Scrolling stays native — wheel, touch, keyboard and indicator
drag operate the viewport directly.
When NOT to use: page-level scrolling (the browser's job), carousels or
paginated media (future indicator/carousel patterns), virtualized long
collections, multi-column tabular data, or nesting scrollers (v1
guarantees a single scroll axis per region). Cross-axis overflow is an
authoring mistake: the scroller scrolls its declared axis only and clips
the other — wrap or size content on the cross axis.

Examples:

A bounded vertical region; the scroller's size comes entirely from your layout and `label` (required) is the accessible name of the scroll region:

```html
<ki-scroller label="Release notes" style="block-size: 12rem">
  <h3>March</h3>
  <p>Indicator fixes and token updates.</p>
  <h3>February</h3>
  <p>Initial scroller release.</p>
</ki-scroller>
```

`orientation="horizontal"` scrolls the inline axis instead; one axis per instance — the cross axis clips, so wrap or size content on it:

```html
<ki-scroller label="Weekly timeline" orientation="horizontal">
  <div style="display: flex; inline-size: max-content; gap: 1rem">
    <span>Mon</span><span>Tue</span><span>Wed</span><span>Thu</span><span>Fri</span>
  </div>
</ki-scroller>
```

Scrolling stays native (wheel, touch, arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End); the viewport joins the Tab order only while content actually overflows, and slotted content keeps its own semantics:

```html
<ki-scroller label="Chat messages" style="block-size: 16rem">
  <ul>
    <li>Morning! Build is green.</li>
    <li>Shipping the docs today.</li>
  </ul>
</ki-scroller>
```

Attributes:
- `label` (string, required): Accessible name of the scroll region ("Release notes", "Chat messages"). Assistive technology receives a `region` with this name whose slotted content keeps its own semantics (FR-006). Documented as required: a scroller without a label renders but exposes no accessible name and fails the accessibility audit (015-ki-progress precedent). The label is never rendered visually.
- `orientation` ("horizontal" | "vertical", default 'vertical'): Declared scroll axis, mapping the design source's `Type` axis: `vertical` (default) scrolls the block axis, `horizontal` the inline axis. One axis per instance; the cross axis clips. A structural axis, never appearance — thickness, shape and colors of the indicator are per-theme `--ki-scroller-*` tokens. An unrecognized value matches no style selector and no `horizontal` code path, so the scroller keeps the default vertical behavior (fallback by CSS construction plus a single strict comparison — no validation code, FR-002/FR-009).

Slots:
- (default): The scrollable content: it keeps its own semantics and sizes the scroll extent along the declared axis.

Parts:
- `viewport`: The scroll viewport: surface, focus ring and, as native scrollbar chrome styled from `--ki-scroller-*` tokens, the indicator.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-scroller-focus-ring-color`: color used by the scroller component for the viewport focus ring: the keyboard-focusable scroll region (FR-005) adopts the ki-dialog focus-ring pair verbatim.
- `--ki-scroller-focus-ring-offset`: dimension used by the scroller component for the viewport focus ring offset (ki-dialog precedent).
- `--ki-scroller-focus-ring-shadow`: shadow used by the scroller component for the viewport focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary 3px 20%-alpha halo, the ki-button double mechanism; completes the theming hook ki-scroller.css already consumes).
- `--ki-scroller-focus-ring-width`: dimension used by the scroller component for the viewport focus ring width (ki-dialog precedent).
- `--ki-scroller-gutter`: dimension used by the scroller component for the clearance on each side of the thumb: the 2px padding-inline of the 8px Scroller rail (rail thickness = thumb-thickness + 2×gutter).
- `--ki-scroller-surface`: color used by the scroller component for the viewport surface: transparent in onmars — the scroller shows the consumer's own surface; a theme may resolve a proper surface here (FR-007).
- `--ki-scroller-thumb-color`: color used by the scroller component for the indicator thumb: Inverse_white/alpha_48 (Black/48 light, White/48 dark) — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI binding Inverse_white/alpha_6 (Black/5 light, White/5 dark), which reads 1.12:1 and 1.09:1 against the content surface. The thumb is the only mark that shows the scroll position, so it takes the first step of the same ramp that clears WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1. The scheme flip rides the semantic layer (specs/023-ki-scroller/design-extraction.md).
- `--ki-scroller-thumb-min-length`: dimension used by the scroller component for the minimum thumb length along the scroll axis: the 16px min-height on the Figma scroll pill; the actual length stays the native visible-fraction proportion (FR-003).
- `--ki-scroller-thumb-radius`: dimension used by the scroller component for the thumb shape: Radius/radius_round bound in Figma — the pill is a radius token, never an attribute (002 shape precedent).
- `--ki-scroller-thumb-thickness`: dimension used by the scroller component for the thumb cross size: the 4px pill measured inside the 8px MarsUI rail (rail = thumb + 2×gutter, verified 2026-07-17).
- `--ki-scroller-track-color`: color used by the scroller component for the track: the MarsUI pill floats directly on the content surface with no visible track — transparent in onmars; a theme opts into a visible track through this token, never an attribute.
- `--ki-scroller-track-inset`: dimension used by the scroller component for the rail end insets: Space/xs bound as the 4px padding along the scroll axis of both Scroller variants (design-extraction §Decisiones 5).
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-search

A query field with a responsive view for suggestions, recent searches and results.

When to use: accept free-text searches and let the user run a typed or suggested
query. Listen for ki-input to update suggestions, and ki-search to render results.
When NOT to use: selecting one value from a fixed set belongs in ki-select.
Use ki-input when a plain search field is enough.

Examples:

# Search examples

```html
<ki-search label="Search Kimen" placeholder="Search Kimen" name="q">
  <ki-search-suggestion value="ki-dialog" description="Component">
    Dialog
  </ki-search-suggestion>
  <ki-search-suggestion recent>button tokens</ki-search-suggestion>
  <section slot="results" aria-label="Results"></section>
</ki-search>
```

```js
const search = document.querySelector('ki-search');

search.addEventListener('ki-input', ({ detail }) => {
  // Load suggestions for detail.value and update the direct children.
});

search.addEventListener('ki-search', ({ detail }) => {
  search.querySelector('[slot="results"]').textContent = `Query: ${detail.value}`;
});
```

Use `ki-clear` to clear host-rendered content and `ki-remove-recent` to
update saved history. Set `loading` during a request. The results slot stays
visible while suggestions load. To offer voice search, supply a button
with an accessible name in the trailing slot and handle its activation.

Attributes:
- `back-label` (string, default 'Back'): Accessible name of the full-screen Back button.
- `clear-label` (string, default 'Clear search'): Accessible name of the query clear button.
- `highlight` (boolean, default true): Emphasize literal, case-insensitive matches in suggestion titles.
- `label` (string, default 'Search'): Accessible name of the search landmark, input and full-screen dialog.
- `loading` (boolean, default false): Show a loading indicator while the host fetches suggestions.
- `loading-label` (string, default 'Loading suggestions'): Accessible name of the loading indicator.
- `mode` ("auto" | "docked" | "fullscreen", default 'auto'): View presentation. Auto uses a full-screen dialog below 600 CSS pixels.
- `name` (string | undefined): Name under which the current query is included in form data.
- `open` (boolean, default false): Whether the search view is open. The field opens it on focus, click or input.
- `placeholder` (string, default ''): Optional hint displayed inside the empty search field.
- `recent-label` (string, default 'Recent searches'): Visible and accessible name of the recent-search group.
- `remove-recent-label` (string, default 'Remove {value}'): Accessible name template for recent-query removal. Use {value} for the query title.
- `suggestion-count-plural` (string, default '{count} suggestions'): Polite announcement for zero or multiple suggestions. Use {count} for the number.
- `suggestion-count-singular` (string, default '1 suggestion'): Polite announcement when the list contains one suggestion.
- `suggestions-label` (string, default 'Suggestions'): Accessible name of the suggestion listbox.
- `value` (string, default ''): Current query. Edits and selected suggestions update this property.

Slots:
- (default): Direct ki-search-suggestion children supply suggestion and recent-query data.
- `leading`: A control or decorative icon at the start of the collapsed or docked bar.
- `results`: Host-rendered results beneath suggestions and recent searches.
- `trailing`: A control or avatar at the end of the collapsed or docked bar. Supply a labelled button here to surface voice search.

Parts:
- `bar`: Collapsed and docked search bar.
- `dialog-bar`: Search bar inside the full-screen view.
- `input`: Native query input in each presentation.
- `option`: A selectable suggestion in the listbox.
- `recent`: Labelled group of recent searches.
- `results`: Container around host-rendered results.
- `view`: Docked popover or full-screen dialog surface.

Events:
- `ki-clear` (CustomEvent<void>): The user cleared the query with the clear control or with Escape.
- `ki-input` (CustomEvent<KiSearchValueDetail>): The current query after 200 ms of inactivity following an edit.
- `ki-remove-recent` (CustomEvent<KiSearchValueDetail>): The removed recent query. Hosts can use this to persist the updated history.
- `ki-search` (CustomEvent<KiSearchValueDetail>): The query to run, emitted on Enter or activation of a suggestion or recent search.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-glyph-size-md`: Medium glyph for body content (20px at the default root size).
- `--ki-layout-spacing-3xl`: The 3xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-md`: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-sm`: The sm spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xl`: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xs`: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-search-bar-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for the bar.
- `--ki-search-bar-bg`: Fill of the collapsed and docked bar.
- `--ki-search-bar-bg-image`: Optional image painted over the bar fill.
- `--ki-search-bar-fg`: Query ink over the search bar.
- `--ki-search-bar-height`: Minimum height of the search bar, 56px at the default root size.
- `--ki-search-bar-placeholder`: Placeholder ink exposed by the Search API.
- `--ki-search-bar-placeholder-fg`: Default contrast pair for placeholder text over the search bar.
- `--ki-search-bar-radius`: Pill corner of the collapsed and docked bar.
- `--ki-search-control-size`: Base size of actions and minimum height of search rows.
- `--ki-search-group-heading-family`: Font family for the recent-query group heading.
- `--ki-search-input-touch-size`: Minimum input font size on coarse pointers to avoid focus zoom.
- `--ki-search-option-active-bg`: Fill of the focused or hovered suggestion.
- `--ki-search-option-active-fg`: Ink of the focused or hovered suggestion.
- `--ki-search-option-active-supporting-fg`: Description ink on the focused or hovered suggestion.
- `--ki-search-view-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for the search view.
- `--ki-search-view-bg`: Raised fill of the docked and full-screen view.
- `--ki-search-view-bg-image`: Optional image painted over the view fill.
- `--ki-search-view-divider`: Divider separating the active field and full-screen results.
- `--ki-search-view-fg`: Ink over the search view.
- `--ki-search-view-radius`: Corner for the docked view.
- `--ki-search-view-shadow`: Resting elevation of the docked view.
- `--ki-search-view-supporting-fg`: Ink for descriptions and the recent-search group label.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size`: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-bold`: semantic font weight for typography weight body bold.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-medium`: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

### ki-search-suggestion

Declarative search suggestion or recent query rendered by its owning ki-search.

When to use: supply one suggested or recent query as a direct ki-search child.
When NOT to use: standalone display, form options or arbitrary results content.
Use the results slot of ki-search for independently rendered results.

Examples:

# Search suggestion examples

```html
<ki-search label="Search components">
  <ki-search-suggestion value="ki-dialog" description="Component">Dialog</ki-search-suggestion>
  <ki-search-suggestion recent>button tokens</ki-search-suggestion>
</ki-search>
```

The child text is the title. When `value` is omitted, that title supplies the
query. Use `recent` for a removable history item.

Attributes:
- `description` (string | undefined): Optional supporting text displayed below the title.
- `recent` (boolean, default false): Display in the removable recent-search group.
- `value` (string | undefined): Query to run. When omitted, the trimmed title is used.

Slots:
- (default): Plain text title displayed in the owning search view.

Parts: none

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-search-suggestion-font-family`: Inherited body typeface on the declarative suggestion host.

### ki-segment

A single choice in a ki-segmented-control.

When to use: offer one mutually exclusive choice with text or a named icon.
When NOT to use: standalone, for navigation, or for form submission.

Examples:

# ki-segment examples

Place each choice directly in a `ki-segmented-control`. Give every choice a
distinct value, and set the selected value on the group.

```html
<ki-segmented-control label="Date range" value="week">
  <ki-segment value="day">Day</ki-segment>
  <ki-segment value="week">Week</ki-segment>
  <ki-segment value="year" disabled>Year</ki-segment>
</ki-segmented-control>
```

Use the `start` slot for a decorative icon. An icon-only option needs
`aria-label`, which also supplies its hover and focus tooltip when enabled.

The all-elements loader registers `ki-tooltip`. When using direct imports or
framework wrappers, register it separately for icon-only options.

Attributes:
- `aria-label` (string | undefined): Accessible name of an icon-only option. An enabled icon-only option also shows this name on focus and hover when ki-tooltip is registered. The all-elements loader includes it. For a text option, use the visible label.
- `disabled` (boolean, default false): Excludes the option from selection and keyboard navigation.
- `value` (string, required): Required nonempty option identifier. Each value must be unique in its group.

Slots:
- (default): Noninteractive visible option label. A label wider than its share of the row wraps onto a second line and every option of the row keeps one height; text that would need a third line ends with an ellipsis, and the full text stays the option's accessible name. Keep it to a few words.
- `start`: Decorative leading icon. Supply aria-label for an icon-only option.

Parts:
- `button`: The native option surface with radio semantics.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-segment-font-size`: Text size of medium and small segments.
- `--ki-segment-font-weight`: Font weight of segment labels.
- `--ki-segment-gap`: Gap between the leading icon and label.
- `--ki-segment-icon-size`: Size of leading artwork.
- `--ki-segment-line-height`: Line height of medium and small segments.
- `--ki-segment-padding-inline`: Inline padding of a medium or small segment.
- `--ki-segmented-control-track-size-md`: Medium track height before density adjustment.
- `--ki-segmented-item-backdrop-filter`: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind an unselected segment.
- `--ki-segmented-item-bg`: Resting surface of an unselected segment, matching the track by default.
- `--ki-segmented-item-bg-image`: Optional image layered over an unselected segment surface.
- `--ki-segmented-item-disabled-fg`: Ink of an unavailable segment.
- `--ki-segmented-item-fg`: Resting ink of an unselected segment, strengthened in contrast-more.
- `--ki-segmented-item-radius`: Corner radius of each segment.
- `--ki-segmented-selected-backdrop-filter`: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind the selected segment.
- `--ki-segmented-selected-bg`: Raised selected surface, lighter than the track in both schemes.
- `--ki-segmented-selected-bg-image`: Optional image layered over the selected segment.
- `--ki-segmented-selected-border-color`: High-contrast selection boundary when elevation or surface differences are subtle.
- `--ki-segmented-selected-border-width`: Width of the selection boundary.
- `--ki-segmented-selected-fg`: Ink of the selected segment.
- `--ki-segmented-selected-shadow`: Elevation of the selected segment.
- `--ki-segmented-track-padding`: Inset between the track and its segments.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-segmented-control

A compact control for one in-place choice among two to five options.

When to use: apply a chart range, view mode, or another immediate setting.
When NOT to use: switching between panels (ki-tabs), submitted form choices
(ki-radio-group), or more than five options (ki-select).

Examples:

# ki-segmented-control examples

## Change a chart range

```html
<ki-segmented-control id="range" label="Chart range" value="week">
  <ki-segment value="day">Day</ki-segment>
  <ki-segment value="week">Week</ki-segment>
  <ki-segment value="month">Month</ki-segment>
</ki-segmented-control>
```

```js
import { defineCustomElement as defineControl } from '@kimen/elements/ki-segmented-control';
import { defineCustomElement as defineSegment } from '@kimen/elements/ki-segment';

defineControl();
defineSegment();

document.querySelector('#range').addEventListener('ki-change', ({ detail }) => {
  updateChartRange(detail.value);
});
```

## Give an icon-only option a name

```html
<ki-segmented-control label="View" size="sm" full-width>
  <ki-segment value="list">List</ki-segment>
  <ki-segment value="board" aria-label="Board">
    <svg slot="start" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M2 2h4v12H2zm6 0h6v7H8z" fill="currentColor"></path>
    </svg>
  </ki-segment>
</ki-segmented-control>
```

The all-elements loader already registers the tooltip. With direct imports
or framework wrappers, register it before mounting an icon-only option.

```js
import { defineCustomElement as defineTooltip } from '@kimen/elements/ki-tooltip';

defineTooltip();
```

Supply a visible label when space permits. The icon-only option takes its
accessible name and hover or focus tooltip from `aria-label`. Keep slotted
content noninteractive.

Attributes:
- `full-width` (boolean, default false): Distribute the available inline space evenly among all segments. A label wider than its equal share wraps onto a second line.
- `label` (string, required): Required accessible name of the group. Use a short name for the setting.
- `size` ("md" | "sm" | "xs", default 'md'): Track size. The default heights are 28, 32 and 40 CSS px respectively; surrounding density settings can increase or decrease targets.
- `value` (string, default ''): Resolved selected value. Set it to choose an option programmatically. Omit it to select the first available option. The value is empty when there are no available options. Programmatic changes are silent.

Slots:
- (default): Two to five direct ki-segment children with distinct nonempty values.

Parts:
- `track`: Surface containing the radiogroup and its options.

Events:
- `ki-change` (CustomEvent<{ value: string }>): Emitted once per changed user choice with the new resolved value.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-segment-font-size-xs`: Text size of extra-small segments.
- `--ki-segment-line-height-xs`: Line height of extra-small segments.
- `--ki-segment-padding-inline-xs`: Inline padding of an extra-small segment.
- `--ki-segmented-control-track-size-md`: Medium track height before density adjustment.
- `--ki-segmented-control-track-size-sm`: Small track height before density adjustment.
- `--ki-segmented-control-track-size-xs`: Extra-small track height before density adjustment.
- `--ki-segmented-radius`: Corner radius of the control track.
- `--ki-segmented-track-backdrop-filter`: Complete CSS backdrop filter behind the track.
- `--ki-segmented-track-bg`: Solid surface for the segment track.
- `--ki-segmented-track-bg-image`: Optional image layered over the track surface.
- `--ki-segmented-track-gap`: Gap between adjacent segments.
- `--ki-segmented-track-padding`: Inset between the track and its segments.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-select

A form-associated select-only combobox for choosing one option from declarative `ki-option` children. Like a native field, it answers `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()`, `setCustomValidity(message)`, `validity`, `validationMessage` and `willValidate` synchronously, on the custom-elements build (not on hosts created by the lazy loader).

When to use: choose exactly one value from a known closed list, especially
when there are roughly five or more choices or space is limited.
When NOT to use: `ki-radio-group` for a few always-visible choices,
`ki-input` for free or searchable text, `ki-checkbox`/`ki-switch` for
binary decisions, or multiselect and command menus.

Examples:

Options are declared as `ki-option` children; the option text is the visible label and `value` is the submitted value:

```html
<ki-select label="Country" name="country" placeholder="Choose a country">
  <ki-option value="es">Spain</ki-option>
  <ki-option value="fr">France</ki-option>
  <ki-option value="pt">Portugal</ki-option>
</ki-select>
```

An option without `value` submits its trimmed label text, and `required` blocks submission while empty:

```html
<form>
  <ki-select label="Team size" name="size" required>
    <ki-option>1-10</ki-option>
    <ki-option>11-50</ki-option>
    <ki-option disabled>51+</ki-option>
  </ki-select>
  <ki-button variant="primary">Continue</ki-button>
</form>
```

## An error from the application

Set `custom-error` to show the application's verdict on the submitted
choice, such as a server-side check. The select is invalid, blocks its form
and is announced as invalid at once. Choosing another option withdraws the
error. Remove the attribute when a new attempt starts: setting the same text
again while it is still set shows nothing.

```html
<ki-select label="Country" name="country" value="ch" custom-error="We do not ship to Switzerland yet.">
  <ki-option value="es">Spain</ki-option>
  <ki-option value="ch">Switzerland</ki-option>
</ki-select>
```

Attributes:
- `custom-error` (string | undefined): An error of the application's own, such as a server-side verdict on the submitted choice ("We do not ship there"). While it holds text the select is invalid, blocks its form, shows the text in place of the help text at once and is announced as invalid. It stops counting when the person chooses another option, or when the form is reset, so it never blocks the corrected answer. It outranks `error-text` and an error set with `setCustomValidity`. When to use: report a verdict from a declarative spec, a live update or a framework binding. Remove it when a new attempt starts. When NOT to use: do not use it for a `required` select left without a choice; `error-text` words that. Setting the same text again while the prop still holds it shows nothing: remove it first, then set it again.
- `disabled` (boolean, default false): Prevents opening, removes the trigger from keyboard reach, and excludes the select from form submission. Boolean presence semantics apply.
- `error-text` (string | undefined): Message shown in place of the help text once a `required` select is left without a choice, and its `validationMessage` ("Choose a country"). Without it the browser's own message shows, in the browser's language. An error set with `custom-error` or `setCustomValidity` outranks it. When NOT to use: do not use it for server-side or cross-field errors; set `custom-error` or call `setCustomValidity` for those.
- `help-text` (string | undefined): One line of help under the trigger, read with it as the combobox description: what the choice decides. While an error shows, the error takes its place. When NOT to use: do not repeat the label, and do not use it for error messages; use `error-text`.
- `label` (string, required): Visible label and accessible-name source for the combobox trigger. When NOT to use: do not omit it; unlabeled selects are invalid usage.
- `label-hint` (string | undefined): Short text shown after the label and read with it as part of the combobox name, so people know before submitting whether to choose: "(optional)" on the few optional fields of a mostly required form, or "(required)" the other way round, in the page's own language. It changes no validation; set `required` for that, and keep the two consistent. When NOT to use: do not put instructions in it (use `help-text`), errors (use `error-text`), or a repeat of the label.
- `name` (string | undefined): Form-data key used when a selected option contributes its value. When NOT to use: omit it when the select should not submit data.
- `placeholder` (string, default ''): Text shown while no option is selected. When NOT to use: do not use it as a replacement for `label`.
- `required` (boolean, default false): Requires a non-empty submitted value. The platform validation message is donated by a hidden native select.
- `size` ("lg" | "md" | "sm" | "xl" | "xs", default 'md'): Token-backed trigger size (`--ki-select-{size}-*` tokens): the trigger is 24, 32, 40, 48 or 56px tall in onmars, with its padding, radius, text and indicator; the label and help text follow in three steps. The listbox and its options keep their size. An unrecognized value matches no style rule and keeps the medium metrics. When to use: match the size of the fields around it. When NOT to use: do not pick a smaller size to fit a dense region or a larger one for touch; declare `data-ki-density` on the region instead, which composes with every size.
- `value` (string, default ''): Live projection of the selected option value, or `""` when unselected. Assigning it selects the first matching option silently; the attribute is the reset/default declaration and is not updated by user commits.

Slots:
- (default): `ki-option` data children. They do not paint; rows are mirrored.

Parts:
- `error`: Error line shown in place of the help text while the select is invalid after the person chose or submitted; a polite live region, starting with a decorative error symbol.
- `help`: Help line under the trigger, read as the combobox description.
- `indicator`: Decorative dropdown indicator.
- `label`: Visible label and accessible-name source.
- `label-hint`: The `label-hint` text after the label text, inside the label and part of the accessible name of the combobox and its listbox; rendered only while a hint is set.
- `listbox`: Popup listbox surface.
- `option`: Mirrored option row rendered in this shadow root.
- `trigger`: Native button carrying the combobox role.
- `value`: Displayed selection or placeholder.

Events:
- `change` (Event): Fired once after the user commits a different option, composed across the shadow boundary and preceded by `input`; `value` is already current when listeners run. When to use: react to the committed choice. When NOT to use: do not expect it for programmatic `value` writes, which are silent.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for translucent components. Use none to turn the effect off.
- `--ki-effect-component-secondary-default-shadow`: MarsUI Component_effect/secondary_default: drop 0/2/1.5/-0.5 plus inner White/3 0/2/3. Pair with --ki-effect-component-backdrop-filter.
- `--ki-elevation-e1`: MarsUI Elevation/e1. Scheme-aware: every layer colors through ki.elevation.shadow.
- `--ki-focus-danger`: MarsUI Focus/danger: persistent 3px spread ring of Outline/danger_base_em_alpha (danger-500 at 20% light / 40% dark) — the danger state signal on Input_field and Dropdown masters (measured rgb(252,220,219) over white). Pairs with a white fill and hairline border; Kimen keeps its opaque danger border on top as a declared a11y deviation.
- `--ki-motion-distance-sm`: Motion travel distance sm (4px): small slide/settle offsets.
- `--ki-motion-distance-xs`: Motion travel distance xs (2px): hover-lift offsets.
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-motion-easing-standard`: Standard interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-option-disabled-bg`: color used by the option component for disabled background.
- `--ki-option-disabled-fg`: color used by the option component for disabled foreground.
- `--ki-option-font-size`: dimension used by the option component for font size.
- `--ki-option-highlight-bg`: color used by the option component for keyboard-highlight background (MarsUI active row = same Black/3 wash plus Elevation/e1; the accent is reserved for the selected tint).
- `--ki-option-highlight-fg`: color used by the option component for highlight foreground.
- `--ki-option-hover-bg`: color used by the option component for hover background (MarsUI hover-overlay-inverse Black/3 wash over the panel — not a solid surface step).
- `--ki-option-hover-fg`: color used by the option component for hover foreground.
- `--ki-option-min-target`: dimension used by the option component for min target (MarsUI Dropmenu row height Space/11xl 36px; comfortably above the 24px a11y floor).
- `--ki-option-padding-inline`: dimension used by the option component for padding inline.
- `--ki-option-radius`: dimension used by the option component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_lg 12px bound on Dropmenu rows).
- `--ki-option-rest-bg`: color used by the option component for rest background (MarsUI Dropmenu rows are transparent over the panel; only hover/selected paint).
- `--ki-option-rest-fg`: color used by the option component for rest foreground.
- `--ki-option-selected-bg`: color used by the option component for selected background.
- `--ki-option-selected-fg`: color used by the option component for selected foreground.
- `--ki-select-border-block-end-width`: dimension used by the select component for border block end width.
- `--ki-select-border-block-start-width`: dimension used by the select component for border block start width.
- `--ki-select-border-inline-end-width`: dimension used by the select component for border inline end width.
- `--ki-select-border-inline-start-width`: dimension used by the select component for border inline start width.
- `--ki-select-border-width`: dimension used by the select component for border width (MarsUI Input_cell strokeWeight 1px; the color stays ki.outline.control per the declared a11y deviation — only the 2px width was undocumented).
- `--ki-select-disabled-bg`: color used by the select component for disabled background.
- `--ki-select-disabled-border`: color used by the select component for disabled border (MarsUI Outline/base_em Black/3).
- `--ki-select-disabled-fg`: color used by the select component for disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled text Text/base_em Gray/400; disabled cells are exempt from the contrast sweep).
- `--ki-select-disabled-label-fg`: color used by the select component for disabled label foreground.
- `--ki-select-focus-bg`: color used by the select component for focus background (MarsUI Dropdown focus fill Surface/Special/light-s0_dark-s4).
- `--ki-select-focus-border`: color used by the select component for focus border (MarsUI active is glow-only: the border stays the rest hairline while Focus/primary carries the emphasis — repointed from ki.outline.primary-high-em per the fidelity audit; material3 keeps the opaque primary border via its override).
- `--ki-select-focus-fg`: color used by the select component for focus foreground.
- `--ki-select-focus-label-fg`: color used by the select component for focus label foreground.
- `--ki-select-focus-ring-color`: color used by the select component for focus ring color.
- `--ki-select-focus-ring-offset`: dimension used by the select component for focus ring offset.
- `--ki-select-focus-ring-shadow`: shadow used by the select component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
- `--ki-select-focus-ring-width`: dimension used by the select component for focus ring width.
- `--ki-select-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for font size.
- `--ki-select-font-weight`: font weight used by the select component for the trigger value (MarsUI UI/Body 1/medium: weight 600).
- `--ki-select-gap`: dimension used by the select component for gap.
- `--ki-select-height`: dimension used by the select component for height.
- `--ki-select-hover-border`: color used by the select component for hover border. Brief §1: hover moves along the neutral outline em ramp (Black/12), matching ki-input/ki-textarea; the primary accent outline is the focus language (Focus/primary), not hover.
- `--ki-select-hover-fg`: color used by the select component for hover foreground.
- `--ki-select-hover-label-fg`: color used by the select component for hover label foreground.
- `--ki-select-indicator-glyph-size`: dimension used by the select component for the chevron glyph box inside the 18px indicator slot (MarsUI Dropdown chevron 8px border-box square drawn by [part=indicator]::before).
- `--ki-select-indicator-size`: dimension used by the select component for indicator size.
- `--ki-select-label-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for label font size (MarsUI UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).
- `--ki-select-label-font-weight`: font weight used by the select component for label font weight.
- `--ki-select-label-gap`: dimension used by the select component for label gap.
- `--ki-select-label-hint-fg`: color used by the select component for the label hint after the label text (spec 047: the supporting-text role, a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI Input_label support text Text/low_em, which reads 2.8-3.13:1 on the onmars light surfaces; under more contrast it strengthens with every other supporting text).
- `--ki-select-label-hint-gap`: dimension used by the select component for the gap between the label text and the label hint (MarsUI Input_label: Space/xs 4px).
- `--ki-select-label-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for label line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).
- `--ki-select-label-padding-inline`: dimension used by the select component for label padding inline (MarsUI Input_label row 2px inset aligning the label ink with the cell radius; matches ki-input/ki-textarea).
- `--ki-select-lg-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for lg font size: body-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 lg, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595).
- `--ki-select-lg-height`: dimension used by the select component for lg height (Input-cell 8016:286 lg, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: 48px).
- `--ki-select-lg-indicator-size`: dimension used by the select component for the lg indicator box (Input-cell 8016:286 lg, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: icon 20px).
- `--ki-select-lg-label-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for the lg label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-lg-label-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for the lg label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-lg-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for lg line height (body-2, Input-cell 8016:286 lg, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595).
- `--ki-select-lg-padding-inline`: dimension used by the select component for lg padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 lg, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Space/xl, 12px).
- `--ki-select-lg-radius`: dimension used by the select component for lg radius (Input-cell 8016:286 lg, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Radius/small-component/lg).
- `--ki-select-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for the trigger value line height (MarsUI body_1 24px).
- `--ki-select-listbox-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter behind the select listbox.
- `--ki-select-listbox-bg`: color used by the select component for listbox background (MarsUI Dropmenu panel Surface/Special/blur_base_light, opaque in onmars v2; pair with --ki-select-listbox-backdrop-filter).
- `--ki-select-listbox-bg-image`: Optional CSS background image layered over the listbox fill. Use none for a solid fill.
- `--ki-select-listbox-max-block-size`: dimension used by the select component for listbox max block size (surface size scale; the former ki.space.25xl reference misused the spacing scale).
- `--ki-select-listbox-offset`: dimension used by the select component for listbox offset.
- `--ki-select-listbox-padding`: dimension used by the select component for listbox padding (Dropmenu master Body: Space/md 8px on every side).
- `--ki-select-listbox-radius`: dimension used by the select component for listbox radius (Dropmenu master 12127:30113: Radius/big-component/xs 16px).
- `--ki-select-listbox-shadow`: shadow used by the select component for the listbox: MarsUI elevation ramp e3 (brief §5), the medium floating-surface level, replacing the former hand-composed offset/color shadow. Declared level: e3 (M3 analog: menu/dialog band; material3 overrides to e2 = md.sys.elevation.level2 for menus).
- `--ki-select-min-target`: dimension used by the select component for min target.
- `--ki-select-padding-inline`: dimension used by the select component for padding inline.
- `--ki-select-placeholder-fg`: color used by the select component for placeholder foreground.
- `--ki-select-radius`: dimension used by the select component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_md 10px; component ramp so personality modes reach it).
- `--ki-select-rest-bg`: color used by the select component for rest background (MarsUI Dropdown rest fill Surface/Special/light-s0_dark-s2: white light, Dark/800 dark).
- `--ki-select-rest-border`: color used by the select component for rest border.
- `--ki-select-rest-fg`: color used by the select component for rest foreground.
- `--ki-select-rest-label-fg`: color used by the select component for rest label foreground.
- `--ki-select-sm-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for sm font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 sm, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595).
- `--ki-select-sm-height`: dimension used by the select component for sm height (Input-cell 8016:286 sm, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: 32px).
- `--ki-select-sm-indicator-size`: dimension used by the select component for the sm indicator box (Input-cell 8016:286 sm, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: icon 16px).
- `--ki-select-sm-label-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for the sm label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-sm-label-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for the sm label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-sm-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for sm line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 sm, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595).
- `--ki-select-sm-padding-inline`: dimension used by the select component for sm padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 sm, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Space/md, 8px).
- `--ki-select-sm-radius`: dimension used by the select component for sm radius (Input-cell 8016:286 sm, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Radius/small-component/sm).
- `--ki-select-xl-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for xl font size: title-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 xl, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595).
- `--ki-select-xl-height`: dimension used by the select component for xl height (Input-cell 8016:286 xl, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: 56px).
- `--ki-select-xl-indicator-size`: dimension used by the select component for the xl indicator box (Input-cell 8016:286 xl, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: icon 24px).
- `--ki-select-xl-label-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for the xl label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 lg step, body-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-xl-label-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for the xl label line height (body-2, Input-label lg; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-xl-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for xl line height (title-2, Input-cell 8016:286 xl, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595).
- `--ki-select-xl-padding-inline`: dimension used by the select component for xl padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 xl, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Space/2xl, 14px).
- `--ki-select-xl-radius`: dimension used by the select component for xl radius (Input-cell 8016:286 xl, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Radius/small-component/xl).
- `--ki-select-xs-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for xs font size: caption-2 (Input-cell 8016:286 xs, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595). Figma draws caption_1, 10px; caption_2, 12px, is the smallest text the library ships (spec 050 D7).
- `--ki-select-xs-height`: dimension used by the select component for xs height (Input-cell 8016:286 xs, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: 24px).
- `--ki-select-xs-indicator-size`: dimension used by the select component for the xs indicator box (Input-cell 8016:286 xs, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: icon 14px).
- `--ki-select-xs-label-font-size`: dimension used by the select component for the xs label font size: the Input-label 12021:6068 sm step, caption-2 (spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-xs-label-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for the xs label line height (caption-2, Input-label sm; spec 050 D4).
- `--ki-select-xs-line-height`: dimension used by the select component for xs line height (caption-2, Input-cell 8016:286 xs, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595).
- `--ki-select-xs-padding-inline`: dimension used by the select component for xs padding inline (Input-cell 8016:286 xs, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Space/sm, 6px).
- `--ki-select-xs-radius`: dimension used by the select component for xs radius (Input-cell 8016:286 xs, composed by Dropdown 12041:1595: Radius/small-component/xs).
- `--ki-surface-hover-overlay-inverse`: semantic color for surface hover overlay inverse.
- `--ki-text-danger-high-em`: semantic color for text danger high em.
- `--ki-text-supporting`: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-para`: semantic dimension for typography line height para.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-medium`: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-normal`: semantic font weight for typography weight body normal.

### ki-sidebar

Side navigation with an expanded panel and an optional icon rail.

When to use: navigate more than five top-level destinations or organize
application destinations in named groups.
When NOT to use: for a few destinations, use top navigation. For mobile
navigation, use a mobile navigation pattern or a drawer.

Examples:

# Sidebar examples

## Grouped navigation

```js
import { defineCustomElement as defineSidebar } from '@kimen/elements/ki-sidebar';
import { defineCustomElement as defineGroup } from '@kimen/elements/ki-sidebar-group';
import { defineCustomElement as defineItem } from '@kimen/elements/ki-sidebar-item';
import { defineCustomElement as defineTooltip } from '@kimen/elements/ki-tooltip';
import '@kimen/elements/icons/house';
import '@kimen/elements/icons/inbox';
import '@kimen/elements/icons/users';

const sidebar = document.querySelector('#main-sidebar');
sidebar.preference = { storageKey: 'sample-app:profile-42:main-sidebar' };

defineTooltip();
defineSidebar();
defineGroup();
defineItem();
```

```html
<ki-sidebar label="Main" collapsible id="main-sidebar">
  <span slot="brand">Kimen</span>
  <ki-sidebar-item href="/" icon-name="house" current>Home</ki-sidebar-item>
  <ki-sidebar-item href="/inbox" icon-name="inbox" count="12">Inbox</ki-sidebar-item>
  <ki-sidebar-group label="Workspace">
    <ki-sidebar-item href="/members" icon-name="users">Members</ki-sidebar-item>
  </ki-sidebar-group>
  <button slot="footer" type="button" aria-label="Account: Ana Garcia">AG</button>
</ki-sidebar>
```

Set the `preference` property before mounting or upgrading the element to
restore the saved mode.
Wire the footer trigger to your application's account menu. Use an app-owned
opaque profile identifier in the storage key, or omit the key and persist
`event.detail.collapsed` through your own preferences service.

## Localized count

```html
<ki-sidebar label="Principal" collapsible collapse-label="Contraer" expand-label="Expandir">
  <ki-sidebar-item href="/bandeja" count="12" count-label="{label}, {count} sin leer">
    Bandeja
  </ki-sidebar-item>
</ki-sidebar>
```

Attributes:
- `collapse-label` (string, default 'Collapse sidebar'): Accessible toggle name while the sidebar is expanded.
- `collapsed` (boolean, default false): Display the icon rail. May also be assigned by the application.
- `collapsible` (boolean, default false): Show the expand and collapse control.
- `expand-label` (string, default 'Expand sidebar'): Accessible toggle name while the sidebar is collapsed.
- `label` (string, default 'Main'): Accessible name for the navigation landmark.

Slots:
- (default): Navigation routes and groups, in reading order.
- `brand`: Presentational brand content for the expanded panel.
- `footer`: Account trigger or other app-owned content available in both modes.

Parts:
- `brand`: Expanded brand region.
- `footer`: Region at the foot of the sidebar.
- `header`: Brand and toggle layout.
- `list`: List of top-level items and groups.
- `nav`: Navigation landmark and surface.
- `toggle`: Native expand and collapse button.

Events:
- `ki-sidebar-change` (CustomEvent<{ collapsed: boolean }>): Reports the new collapsed state after a user toggle. Programmatic writes are silent.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-sidebar-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for the panel.
- `--ki-sidebar-bg`: Navigation panel background.
- `--ki-sidebar-bg-image`: Optional image over the panel background.
- `--ki-sidebar-border`: Navigation panel outline.
- `--ki-sidebar-border-width`: Width of the panel outline.
- `--ki-sidebar-brand-weight`: Weight of the optional brand label.
- `--ki-sidebar-collapsed-width`: Compact rail inline size.
- `--ki-sidebar-fg`: Navigation panel text and brand ink.
- `--ki-sidebar-font-family`: Typeface of sidebar controls and copy.
- `--ki-sidebar-font-size`: Font size of navigation labels.
- `--ki-sidebar-gap`: Space between panel regions and between row contents.
- `--ki-sidebar-icon-size`: Leading and toggle icon edge.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for the row or toggle.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-bg`: Resting row background.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-bg-image`: Optional image over navigation row and toggle backgrounds.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-fg`: Resting row ink, with contrast-more support.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-gap`: Gap between rows.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-height`: Base row and toggle height before density adjustment.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-hover-bg`: Hovered navigation row background.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-hover-fg`: Hovered navigation row ink.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-radius`: Corner of a row or toggle.
- `--ki-sidebar-line-height`: Line height of navigation labels.
- `--ki-sidebar-padding`: Inset between the panel border and its content.
- `--ki-sidebar-radius`: Navigation panel corner.
- `--ki-sidebar-width`: Expanded navigation panel inline size.
- `--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size`: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

### ki-sidebar-group

A named list of routes within sidebar navigation.

When to use: give related sidebar destinations a common heading.
When NOT to use: as a destination or outside ki-sidebar.

Examples:

# Sidebar group example

```html
<ki-sidebar label="Project">
  <ki-sidebar-group label="Workspace">
    <ki-sidebar-item href="/members">Members</ki-sidebar-item>
    <ki-sidebar-item href="/settings" current>Settings</ki-sidebar-item>
  </ki-sidebar-group>
</ki-sidebar>
```

Attributes:
- `label` (string, required): Visible group heading and accessible name of the nested list.

Slots:
- (default): One or more ki-sidebar-item routes.

Parts:
- `heading`: Group heading, visually hidden in the rail.
- `list`: List named by the group heading.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-sidebar-font-family`: Typeface of sidebar controls and copy.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter behind the group heading.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-bg`: Group heading background.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-bg-image`: Optional image over the heading background.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-fg`: Group heading ink, with contrast-more support.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-font-family`: Group heading typeface.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-font-size`: Group heading font size.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-gap`: Space before a group of routes.
- `--ki-sidebar-group-line-height`: Group heading line height.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-gap`: Gap between rows.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-padding`: Inline inset of an expanded row.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-weight`: Weight of the navigation label.

### ki-sidebar-item

One destination in a sidebar.

When to use: link to a named destination in ki-sidebar or ki-sidebar-group.
Register ki-tooltip once when using direct component imports for a rail.
When NOT to use: for commands, nested controls, or standalone links outside the sidebar.

Examples:

# Sidebar item example

Load `@kimen/elements/icons/inbox` to use the named icon.

```html
<ki-sidebar label="Main" collapsed>
  <ki-sidebar-item href="/inbox" icon-name="inbox" count="12" current>Inbox</ki-sidebar-item>
</ki-sidebar>
```

Attributes:
- `count` (number | undefined): Positive unread count. Fractional values round down.
- `count-label` (string, default '{label}, {count} new'): Accessible count template, using the {label} and {count} placeholders.
- `current` (boolean, default false): Mark this destination as the current page.
- `href` (string | undefined, URL): Destination resolved by a native link. Omit for a static row.
- `icon-name` (string | undefined): Name of a registered Lucide glyph. Import its per-icon entry point first.

Slots:
- (default): The destination name as text or static inline content.
- `start`: One decorative icon that overrides icon-name.

Parts:
- `count`: Expanded pill or rail dot.
- `item`: Navigation link or static row.
- `label`: Destination text.
- `start`: Leading icon holder.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-sidebar-border-width`: Width of the panel outline.
- `--ki-sidebar-font-family`: Typeface of sidebar controls and copy.
- `--ki-sidebar-font-size`: Font size of navigation labels.
- `--ki-sidebar-gap`: Space between panel regions and between row contents.
- `--ki-sidebar-icon-size`: Leading and toggle icon edge.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for the row or toggle.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-bg`: Resting row background.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-bg-image`: Optional image over navigation row and toggle backgrounds.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-count-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter behind the count.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-count-bg`: Expanded count pill background.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-count-bg-image`: Optional image over the count background.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-count-fg`: Expanded count digits.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-current-bg`: Current destination background.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-current-fg`: Current destination ink.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-dot-bg`: Unread dot fill in rail mode.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-dot-offset`: Inset of the dot from the row block-start and inline-end edges.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-dot-ring`: Outer ring that separates the rail dot from the row.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-fg`: Resting row ink, with contrast-more support.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-height`: Base row and toggle height before density adjustment.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-hover-bg`: Hovered navigation row background.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-hover-fg`: Hovered navigation row ink.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-padding`: Inline inset of an expanded row.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-radius`: Corner of a row or toggle.
- `--ki-sidebar-item-weight`: Weight of the navigation label.
- `--ki-sidebar-line-height`: Line height of navigation labels.
- `--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size`: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

### ki-skeleton

Decorative placeholder shapes that reserve space for loading content.

When to use: Reserve the expected layout of a card, list, or assistant reply
while it loads. Give the surrounding region an accessible name and set
its aria-busy state. Show the skeleton after about 300 ms of waiting.
When NOT to use: For a standalone loading announcement, progress measurement,
or interactive control. Put content and loading feedback in the caller's region.

Examples:

# Using ki-skeleton

Define the component when using direct imports.

```js
import { defineCustomElement } from '@kimen/elements/ki-skeleton';
defineCustomElement();
```

## Match the expected layout

```html
<section aria-label="Assistant is writing" aria-busy="true">
  <ki-skeleton lines="3"></ki-skeleton>
</section>

<section aria-label="Loading project" aria-busy="true">
  <ki-skeleton shape="circle" size="2.5rem"></ki-skeleton>
  <ki-skeleton shape="rect" block-size="6rem"></ki-skeleton>
</section>
```

The last of multiple text lines is shorter. Use `inline-size` and `block-size` to match the dimensions of the incoming content. Set `animated="false"` to use a static fill.

## Skip the flash on fast loads

Reserve the expected block size immediately. Use `hidden` until the request has been pending for about 300 ms.

```html
<section id="project" aria-label="Loading project" aria-busy="true" style="min-block-size:6rem">
  <ki-skeleton hidden shape="rect" block-size="6rem"></ki-skeleton>
</section>
```

```js
const region = document.querySelector('#project');
const placeholder = region.querySelector('ki-skeleton');
const reveal = setTimeout(() => {
  placeholder.hidden = false;
}, 300);

try {
  const project = await new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => resolve({ name: 'Roadmap' }), 900);
  });
  region.textContent = project.name;
} finally {
  clearTimeout(reveal);
  placeholder.remove();
  region.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
  region.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Project');
}
```

Use this script in a module after the section is mounted. Change the simulated request to 150 ms to see the fast path. In an application, use the real request and show its error state in the same region.

Attributes:
- `animated` (boolean, default true): Sweep a highlight while the user permits motion. Set false to use a static placeholder. Shimmer also stops under reduced motion and forced colours.
- `block-size` (string | undefined): CSS length for the block axis. For text, this is the height of each line. Use it to reserve the height of the content that will replace the shape.
- `inline-size` (string | undefined): CSS length for the inline axis. Use it to match a fixed content width. Text and rectangles otherwise fill available inline space.
- `lines` (number, default 1, minimum 1, maximum 20): Number of text lines. Use a whole number from 1 to 20 for the expected paragraph length. Extra lines are ignored for circles and rectangles.
- `shape` ("circle" | "rect" | "text", default 'text'): Match the placeholder to the expected text, avatar, or rectangular content.
- `size` (string | undefined): CSS length shared by both axes. Use it for circles or square blocks. An axis-specific override takes precedence.

Slots: none

Parts:
- `shape`: Each painted text line, circle or rectangle.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-skeleton-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter behind a loading shape. Defaults to none.
- `--ki-skeleton-bg`: Base fill of the decorative loading shapes.
- `--ki-skeleton-bg-image`: Optional image layered over the static fill. Defaults to none.
- `--ki-skeleton-circle-radius`: Proportional corner radius of the circular shape.
- `--ki-skeleton-circle-size`: Default diameter of the circle.
- `--ki-skeleton-highlight`: Peak colour of the animated loading highlight.
- `--ki-skeleton-last-line-scale`: Fraction of the usual line width occupied by the final line in multiline text.
- `--ki-skeleton-line-gap`: Block-axis space between text lines.
- `--ki-skeleton-line-size`: Default height of each text line.
- `--ki-skeleton-radius`: Corner radius of text lines and rectangles.
- `--ki-skeleton-rect-size`: Default block size of the rectangle.
- `--ki-skeleton-shimmer-duration`: Duration of a shimmer sweep.
- `--ki-skeleton-shimmer-easing`: Easing of the shimmer sweep.
- `--ki-skeleton-shimmer-image`: Image of the moving highlight. Use currentColor to inherit the highlight colour.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-slider

Adjusts a value or an interval on a bounded scale.

When to use: coarse adjustments such as volume, balance or a price filter,
with a descriptive label.
When NOT to use: when people need to enter exact numbers or choose among a
few named options. Use a number input or radio group for those tasks.

Examples:

# Slider examples

Import the element and one theme stylesheet before mounting the examples.

```js
import '@kimen/tokens/css';
import { defineCustomElement } from '@kimen/elements/ki-slider';

defineCustomElement();
```

```html
<form>
  <ki-slider label="Volume" name="volume" help-text="Playback level"
    min="0" max="100" step="1" value="60" marks="5" format="percent"></ki-slider>
  <ki-slider label="Price per night" name="price" range
    value="20,80" format="currency" currency="EUR"></ki-slider>
  <button type="reset">Reset</button>
</form>

<ki-slider label="Exposure" centered min="-50" max="50" value="-20"></ki-slider>
<ki-slider label="Bass" orientation="vertical" max="10" value="4"></ki-slider>
```

A named slider contributes one form entry. The form above starts with
`volume=60` and `price=20,80`. Range values always run from lower to upper.
The closest `lang` controls the display format. Localize the thumb suffixes
through `minimum-label` and `maximum-label`.

```js
const volume = document.querySelector('ki-slider[name="volume"]');
volume.addEventListener('input', () => previewVolume(volume.value));
volume.addEventListener('change', () => saveVolume(volume.value));
```

The neutral catalog exposes the `change` action event. Bind it to a declared
action to receive the current value on commit.

Attributes:
- `centered` (boolean, default false): Shows a midpoint tick and fills from that point to a single thumb.
- `currency` (string, default 'EUR'): ISO 4217 code used with currency format.
- `disabled` (boolean, default false): Makes the slider unavailable for pointer, keyboard and form submission.
- `format` ("currency" | "number" | "percent", default 'number'): Display format for the readout and accessible values.
- `help-text` (string | undefined): Optional supporting text, read as the description of each thumb.
- `label` (string | undefined, default 'Slider'): Visible base name. Use a task-specific, localized label.
- `marks` (number, default 0, minimum 0, maximum 100): Number of evenly spaced tick intervals, up to 100. Zero hides ticks.
- `max` (number, default 100): Inclusive upper bound. A maximum below min collapses the scale.
- `maximum-label` (string | undefined, default 'maximum'): Localized suffix for the upper thumb's accessible name.
- `min` (number, default 0): Inclusive lower bound and step origin.
- `minimum-label` (string | undefined, default 'minimum'): Localized suffix for the lower thumb's accessible name.
- `name` (string | undefined): Native form key. Omit when the value should remain local to the control.
- `orientation` ("horizontal" | "vertical", default 'horizontal'): Axis of the scale. A vertical scale increases towards the top.
- `range` (boolean, default false): Enables two non-crossing thumbs in minimum then maximum tab order.
- `step` (number, default 1): Positive increment. Values snap from min and max is always reachable.
- `value` (number | string | undefined): Current selection as a number or, in range mode, a comma-separated pair. HTML attributes also accept the scalar as numeric text. Defaults to min for one thumb and to both bounds for a range. User updates are normalized.

Slots: none

Parts:
- `center-tick`: Midpoint mark on a centered scale.
- `field`: Layout containing the visible label, value, controls and help.
- `fill`: Active portion of the rail.
- `help`: Supporting text associated with each thumb.
- `label`: Visible text used to name the control.
- `mark`: Decorative scale mark at an interval boundary.
- `thumb`: Focusable pointer target for one end of the selection.
- `track`: Inactive rail between the two ends of the scale.
- `value`: Formatted value or interval shown beside the label.

Events:
- `change` (Event): Bubbles once when a pointer operation commits a different selection or a keyboard action changes it. Read the current host value. For updates during a drag, listen for the standard bubbling `input` event. Programmatic updates and form resets are silent.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-slider-coarse-target`: Minimum target size on a coarse pointer.
- `--ki-slider-fill-backdrop-filter`: Optional effect behind the active rail.
- `--ki-slider-fill-bg`: Colour of the active section of the rail.
- `--ki-slider-fill-bg-image`: Optional image painted on the active rail.
- `--ki-slider-gap`: Gap between the slider control and its labels.
- `--ki-slider-label-bg`: Background beneath the field label.
- `--ki-slider-label-fg`: Ink of the field label.
- `--ki-slider-mark-width`: Thickness of each interval tick.
- `--ki-slider-radius`: Round rail, grip and midpoint tick corners.
- `--ki-slider-text-bg`: Background beneath the value readout and help.
- `--ki-slider-text-fg`: Ink of the value readout and help.
- `--ki-slider-thumb-backdrop-filter`: Optional effect behind the grip.
- `--ki-slider-thumb-bg`: Grip surface behind the outline.
- `--ki-slider-thumb-bg-image`: Optional image painted on the grip.
- `--ki-slider-thumb-border`: Outline colour of the visible grip.
- `--ki-slider-thumb-border-width`: Outline thickness of the visible grip.
- `--ki-slider-thumb-shadow`: Optional grip elevation.
- `--ki-slider-thumb-size`: Diameter of the visible grip within the pointer target.
- `--ki-slider-track-backdrop-filter`: Optional effect behind the inactive rail.
- `--ki-slider-track-bg`: Inactive rail colour against the surrounding surface.
- `--ki-slider-track-bg-image`: Optional image painted on the inactive rail.
- `--ki-slider-track-height`: Inactive rail thickness.
- `--ki-slider-vertical-length`: Length of the vertical rail.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-medium`: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

### ki-source

Declares one named web source for a `ki-sources` list.

When to use: As a direct child of `ki-sources`. In HTML provide an `id`,
`href` and `title`; in guarded specs provide `source-id`, `href` and
`title`. Use the same identifier on any citation of the source.
When NOT to use: For standalone links outside a source list; use `ki-link`.

Examples:

# Using ki-source

Declare a source directly inside the default slot of `ki-sources`.

```html
<ki-sources open>
  <ki-source id="methods" href="/methods" title="Study design" snippet="How the study ran."></ki-source>
</ki-sources>
```

Use a unique identifier in the current document or shadow root. In a
guarded spec, use the `source-id` prop instead of the native `id`. The
disclosure displays the hostname from the resolved URL.

Attributes:
- `href` (string, required, URL): Source destination. Accepts HTTP(S) URLs and relative web references. The source list shows the resolved hostname.
- `snippet` (string | undefined): Optional plain-text excerpt displayed in the source card.
- `source-id` (string | undefined): Source identifier in this document or shadow root. Overrides the native HTML `id` when set. Use this value in guarded specs and in citation refs.
- `title` (string, required): Required plain-text source title. In HTML use the `title` attribute.

Slots: none

Parts: none

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-sources

A disclosure with the ordered sources behind an answer.

When to use: To show the evidence behind an answer. Add direct `ki-source`
children and place `ki-citation` markers next to the claims they support.
When NOT to use: For ordinary navigation, unrelated links, or form controls.

Examples:

# Using Sources

Put a citation immediately after the clause it supports. Put the source
definitions directly inside the corresponding disclosure. The list shows
sources in order of first citation and adds uncited sources in declaration order.

```html
<p>The study design<ki-citation ref="methods"></ki-citation> explains the results.</p>
<ki-sources>
  <ki-source
    id="methods"
    href="https://example.org/methods"
    title="Study design"
    snippet="How the study ran."
  ></ki-source>
</ki-sources>
```

Use `open` to start with the list expanded. Use unique source identifiers
within each document or shadow root. Hover or focus a citation to see its
title and hostname. Activate it to expand the list and focus the title link.
The card links can be used independently of the inline markers.

When importing individual elements, register all three tags with their
respective `defineCustomElement()` functions. Use `citationRef` and
`sourceTitle` as component props in JSX. In a guarded spec, use keys
`ref`, `source-id`, `title` and `href` on their respective nodes. Put
the citation in a `div` primitive if it shares a line with text.

Provide the local language through `label-template`, `source-count-label`,
and `sources-count-label`. Titles and snippets are plain text. HTTP(S) URLs
and relative web references work in authored HTML. Guarded specs also follow
the application's allowed-origin policy.

Attributes:
- `open` (boolean, default false): Whether the disclosure is expanded. Set to show the list initially.
- `source-count-label` (string, default '{count} source'): Localized summary when there is one source. Use `{count}` for its number.
- `sources-count-label` (string, default '{count} sources'): Localized summary for multiple sources. Use `{count}` for their number.

Slots:
- (default): Direct `ki-source` definitions for this answer.

Parts:
- `disclosure`: Native expandable section.
- `domain`: Hostname derived from the link destination.
- `list`: Ordered list of sources.
- `number`: Source order marker inside the card.
- `snippet`: Optional excerpt.
- `source`: Source card link.
- `summary`: Disclosure control with the localized source count.
- `title`: Visible title of the link.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-source-card-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for a source card.
- `--ki-source-card-bg`: Resting background of a source card.
- `--ki-source-card-bg-image`: Optional decorative image over a source card.
- `--ki-source-card-border`: Border color of a source card.
- `--ki-source-card-border-width`: Border width of a source card.
- `--ki-source-card-fg`: Text on a resting source card.
- `--ki-source-card-hover-bg`: Background of a hovered source card.
- `--ki-source-card-hover-fg`: Text on a hovered source card.
- `--ki-source-card-padding`: Inset around source card content.
- `--ki-source-card-radius`: Corner radius of a source card.
- `--ki-source-number-bg`: Background of the number in a source card.
- `--ki-source-number-fg`: Text color of the number in a source card.
- `--ki-source-number-radius`: Corner radius of the number in a source card.
- `--ki-source-number-size`: Minimum size of the number in a source card.
- `--ki-sources-list-gap`: Gap between source cards.
- `--ki-sources-max-inline-size`: Maximum line length of the source disclosure.
- `--ki-sources-summary-bg`: Background of the source-count control.
- `--ki-sources-summary-fg`: Text on the source-count control.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-medium`: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold`: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

### ki-spinner

A compact status for an indeterminate wait.

When to use: show brief inline activity such as saving a change or running a
tool. Choose typing dots for an assistant that is thinking. Set a localized
label that names the activity and mount the spinner when the wait starts.
When NOT to use: use ki-progress for page-level work or a known fraction of
a task. Use ki-alert for persistent notices.

Examples:

# ki-spinner examples

## Inline save status

Insert the spinner when the save begins. Remove it when the save ends.

```html
<ki-spinner size="sm" label="Saving changes…" show-label></ki-spinner>
```

## Assistant status

Use a visually hidden label when the surrounding UI already describes the
activity.

```html
<ki-spinner variant="dots" label="Assistant is thinking"></ki-spinner>
```

## Custom-elements entry point

```ts
import { defineCustomElement } from '@kimen/elements/ki-spinner';

defineCustomElement();
```

Attributes:
- `label` (string, required): Localized name of the ongoing activity, such as "Saving changes". Supply a meaningful label for every spinner, even when the text is hidden. Use the activity's name whenever it can be more specific than "Loading".
