- `show-label` (boolean, default false): Display the label beside the graphic when sighted users also need the activity description. The same text names the status in either case.
- `size` ("lg" | "md" | "sm", default 'md'): Diameter of the ring. Choose the size that fits the surrounding content. Dots use a fixed size. Unrecognized values draw the medium ring.
- `variant` ("dots" | "ring", default 'ring'): Use a ring for general inline activity and dots for assistant typing or thinking. Unrecognized values draw a ring.

Slots: none

Parts:
- `dots`: Group of three animated dots, in the dots variant.
- `label`: Activity text, adjacent to the graphic when show-label is set.
- `ring`: Rotating ring with a track and indicator, in the ring variant.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-spinner-dot-delay`: Delay between consecutive typing dots.
- `--ki-spinner-dot-duration`: Typing pulse period.
- `--ki-spinner-dot-easing`: Easing of the typing pulse.
- `--ki-spinner-dot-gap`: Gap between dots.
- `--ki-spinner-dot-scale-min`: Smallest scale of a dot during the pulse.
- `--ki-spinner-dot-size`: Diameter of each dot at full size.
- `--ki-spinner-indicator`: Ink of the revolving ring segment.
- `--ki-spinner-label-bg`: Background of the inline activity label.
- `--ki-spinner-label-fg`: Ink of the visible label and the typing dots.
- `--ki-spinner-label-font-family`: Font family of the visible label.
- `--ki-spinner-label-font-size`: Font size of the visible label.
- `--ki-spinner-label-gap`: Gap between the graphic and the visible label.
- `--ki-spinner-label-line-height`: Line height of the visible label.
- `--ki-spinner-radius`: Round corners of the ring and dots.
- `--ki-spinner-ring-duration`: Standard ring rotation period.
- `--ki-spinner-ring-duration-reduced`: Ring rotation period when reduced motion is requested.
- `--ki-spinner-ring-easing`: Easing for ring rotation.
- `--ki-spinner-size`: Default ring diameter.
- `--ki-spinner-size-lg`: Large ring diameter.
- `--ki-spinner-size-sm`: Small ring diameter.
- `--ki-spinner-stroke`: Stroke width of the small and medium rings.
- `--ki-spinner-stroke-lg`: Stroke width of the large ring.
- `--ki-spinner-track`: Ink of the ring track.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-stack

A passive flex layout for content on one axis.

When to use: arrange content in a vertical sequence or a horizontal row with
consistent token spacing.
When NOT to use: for page shells, painted grouping (use ki-card), or tabular data.

Examples:

# Stack examples

A vertical sequence uses the default direction and the medium spacing step.

```html
<ki-stack>
  <h2>Account</h2>
  <p>Review the settings for your workspace.</p>
  <ki-button variant="secondary">Edit settings</ki-button>
</ki-stack>
```

A toolbar keeps its source order with a horizontal axis, wrapping and a
growing label. Place `data-grow` on a direct child to give it a share of the
available free space.

```html
<ki-stack direction="row" gap="sm" justify="between" align="center" wrap>
  <strong data-grow>Order summary</strong>
  <ki-button variant="secondary">Cancel</ki-button>
  <ki-button variant="primary">Save</ki-button>
</ki-stack>
```

Attributes:
- `align` ("baseline" | "center" | "end" | "start" | "stretch", default 'stretch'): Cross-axis alignment, stretch by default.
- `direction` ("column" | "row", default 'column'): Main axis, column by default.
- `gap` ("10xl" | "11xl" | "12xl" | "13xl" | "14xl" | "15xl" | "16xl" | "17xl" | "18xl" | "19xl" | "20xl" | "21xl" | "22xl" | "23xl" | "24xl" | "25xl" | "26xl" | "2xl" | "3xl" | "4xl" | "5xl" | "6xl" | "7xl" | "8xl" | "9xl" | "lg" | "md" | "sm" | "xl" | "xs" | "xxs" | "zero", default 'md'): Kimen spacing step, md by default. Unsupported values keep the default gap.
- `justify` ("between" | "center" | "end" | "start", default 'start'): Main-axis distribution, start by default. Use between to distribute spare space.
- `wrap` (boolean, default false): Allow items to continue on a new line. Defaults to false.

Slots:
- (default): The content in reading order. A direct child with data-grow takes a share of free space.

Parts:
- `stack`: The flex layout containing the slotted content.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-layout-spacing-md`: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-stack-gap`: Default gap of a stack.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-stat

A key metric with an optional comparison against a reference period.

When to use: Summarize one numeric metric in a dashboard or report. Set
direction to lower-is-better for metrics such as latency and neutral for
changes that carry no favorable or unfavorable meaning.
When NOT to use: Present a sequence of readings or inspect multiple data
points. Use a chart or table with a text equivalent for that data.

Examples:

# Stat

Use one stat for one key number. Choose the preference for the metric. Here,
the render time went down and the change is favorable.

```html
<ki-stat
  label="Median render time"
  value="84"
  unit="ms"
  delta="-9"
  delta-label="vs last week"
  direction="lower-is-better"
></ki-stat>
```

For a percentage comparison beside a count, set `deltaFormat` as a property.
Percent formatting takes a fraction, so 0.12 reads as 12%.

```html
<ki-stat id="active-surfaces" label="Active surfaces" value="1284" delta="0.12" delta-label="vs last week"></ki-stat>
```

```js
document.querySelector('#active-surfaces').deltaFormat = { style: 'percent' };
```

With no `delta`, the card shows the current value alone. For a trend that carries
no judgment, use `direction="neutral"`. For an informative sparkline, give the
chart a text equivalent through its own HTML semantics.

```html
<ki-stat label="Sales" value="750">
  <svg slot="chart" role="img" aria-label="Sales rose from 680 to 750 this week" viewBox="0 0 80 20" width="80" height="20">
    <path d="M1 17 L13 11 L27 14 L39 4 L52 8 L67 5 L79 1" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"></path>
  </svg>
</ki-stat>
```

Attributes:
- `delta` (number | undefined): Optional finite change. Its sign determines the trend and its magnitude is displayed.
- `delta-label` (string | undefined): Localized comparison period, such as "vs last week".
- `direction` ("higher-is-better" | "lower-is-better" | "neutral", default 'higher-is-better'): Which direction is favorable for this metric. Use neutral to avoid a judgment.
- `down-label` (string, default 'down'): Localized spoken direction for a negative delta.
- `label` (string, required): Localized name of the metric, such as "Median render time".
- `unit` (string | undefined): Literal suffix for decimal readings, such as "ms".
- `up-label` (string, default 'up'): Localized spoken direction for a positive delta.
- `value` (number, required): Current finite reading.

Slots:
- `chart`: An optional sparkline after the summary. Give informative charts a textual equivalent, and hide charts that repeat the summary.

Parts:
- `card`: The surface containing the metric and chart.
- `comparison`: The optional row with delta and reference period.
- `delta`: The trend glyph and formatted comparison magnitude.
- `label`: The visible metric label.
- `reference`: The visible comparison period.
- `trend`: The decorative rising or falling trend glyph.
- `value`: The formatted current reading and its unit.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-stat-backdrop-filter`: Complete optional filter behind the metric surface.
- `--ki-stat-bg`: Raised surface of the metric card.
- `--ki-stat-bg-image`: Optional image layered over the metric surface.
- `--ki-stat-border`: Subtle metric card outline.
- `--ki-stat-border-width`: Width of the metric card outline.
- `--ki-stat-delta-danger-fg`: Ink of an unfavorable comparison.
- `--ki-stat-delta-line-height`: Line height of the comparison.
- `--ki-stat-delta-neutral-fg`: Ink of an unchanged or ungraded comparison.
- `--ki-stat-delta-size`: Text size of the comparison.
- `--ki-stat-delta-success-fg`: Ink of a favorable comparison.
- `--ki-stat-emphasis-weight`: Weight of the main reading and comparison magnitude.
- `--ki-stat-gap`: Space between the reading and comparison or chart.
- `--ki-stat-label-fg`: Ink of the metric label and comparison period.
- `--ki-stat-label-line-height`: Line height of the metric label.
- `--ki-stat-label-size`: Text size of the metric label.
- `--ki-stat-padding`: Insets around the metric and chart.
- `--ki-stat-radius`: Corner radius of the metric card.
- `--ki-stat-trend-gap`: Space between the trend glyph and comparison magnitude.
- `--ki-stat-trend-size`: Size of the rising or falling trend glyph.
- `--ki-stat-value-fg`: Ink of the main reading.
- `--ki-stat-value-font-family`: Typeface of the main reading.
- `--ki-stat-value-letter-spacing`: Spacing between digits in the main reading.
- `--ki-stat-value-line-height`: Line height of the main reading.
- `--ki-stat-value-size`: Size of the main reading.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-status

A tiny, non-interactive status dot that marks the state of a nearby item.

When to use: mark a state with minimal footprint adjacent to (or overlaid
on) the item it describes: presence on an avatar, health of a service
list entry, connection state in a toolbar. Label it (`label`) or pair it
with adjacent visible text — color is never the only carrier of the
meaning (WCAG 1.4.1).
When NOT to use: short labeled status text (that pill is ki-badge — this dot
never renders text), notification counters or the overlay attachment
mechanism (a future, separate nav-badge concern), messages that need
attention or announcement (ki-alert — the dot has no live region),
progress or loading (ki-progress). An unlabeled dot without adjacent
visible text is an authoring mistake (WCAG 1.4.1).

Examples:

`tone` declares semantic intent and `label` exposes the dot as a named non-interactive image; an unrecognized tone keeps the neutral appearance:

```html
<ki-status tone="success" label="Online"></ki-status>
<ki-status tone="danger" label="Build failing"></ki-status>
```

Without a `label` the dot is decorative and contributes nothing to the accessibility tree — adjacent visible text must then carry the meaning (color is never the only carrier, WCAG 1.4.1):

```html
<p><ki-status tone="success"></ki-status> Online</p>
```

`ring` keeps the dot distinguishable over media; positioning the overlay is the consumer's layout concern, and the ring never shifts layout:

```html
<div style="position: relative">
  <img src="avatar.png" alt="" />
  <ki-status
    tone="success"
    ring
    label="Online"
    style="position: absolute; inset-block-end: 0; inset-inline-end: 0"
  ></ki-status>
</div>
```

Attributes:
- `label` (string | undefined): Accessible name for the state ("Online", "Build failing"). With a label the dot is exposed to assistive technology as a named non-interactive image (role `img`); without one it is decorative and contributes nothing to the accessibility tree — the meaning must then live in adjacent visible text (FR-003, FR-008). The label is never rendered visually: visible status text belongs to ki-badge. Runtime changes are not announced (no live region, FR-005).
- `ring` (boolean, default false): Draws a separating ring around the dot for placement over media (an avatar photo), keeping it distinguishable from the pixels beneath. A per-instance functional axis — MarsUI ships Outline=True|False as sibling variants under one theme (recorded deviation from the 002 token-only rule) — while ring width and color stay per-theme `--ki-status-ring-*` tokens. The ring paints outside the dot's box and never shifts layout.
- `tone` ("danger" | "info" | "neutral" | "success" | "warning", default 'neutral'): Semantic intent, never appearance: each tone resolves its fill from the per-theme `--ki-status-{tone}-color` tokens. An unrecognized value matches no style selector, so the dot keeps the neutral appearance (fallback by CSS construction — no validation code, FR-007).

Slots: none

Parts:
- `dot`: The dot itself: size, tone fill, radius, ring and effects.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-easing-emphasized-decelerate`: Expressive entrance curve. M3 md.sys.motion.easing.emphasized-decelerate. onmars: the MarsUI decelerate curve (ki.easing.out).
- `--ki-motion-easing-standard`: Standard interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-status-danger-color`: color used by the status component for the danger tone fill: Surface/danger_med_em, the exact variable bound to the Type=danger Status variant (Danger/500).
- `--ki-status-info-color`: color used by the status component for the info tone fill: Surface/info_high_em (Info/600 light, Info/400 dark) — one step above the med-em 500 pattern the success and danger tones follow, because Info/500 reads 2.29:1 on the light page and WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 of the dot (FR-008). No Figma Status variant ships an info Type, so the fill remains an extrapolation onto the Info ramp (001 contract, 010/015 precedent) declared for founder ratification.
- `--ki-status-neutral-color`: color used by the status component for the neutral tone fill: ki.outline.control, the semantic 3:1 non-text floor (Black/48 light, White/48 dark; md.sys.color.outline in material3) — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI binding Surface/disabled_high_em (Gray/500 light, White/32 dark), which reads 2.10:1 and 2.78:1 against the page where WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1 of the dot (FR-008). MarsUI's disabled gray still maps to the charter neutral tone (spec Assumptions).
- `--ki-status-radius`: dimension used by the status component for the dot shape: Radius/radius_round bound in Figma — the round dot is a radius token, never an attribute (002 shape precedent).
- `--ki-status-ring-color`: color used by the status component for the separating ring: Outline/inverse_black, the exact variable bound to Outline=True variants — white over light surfaces, black over dark ones, so the ring reads as a cutout from the underlying media (FR-002).
- `--ki-status-ring-width`: dimension used by the status component for the separating ring: the 2px stroke on every Outline=True Status variant (FR-002).
- `--ki-status-shadow`: shadow used by the status component for the dot effects: the exact MarsUI pair on every Status variant — e1 drop (0/1/1/-0.5 in the scheme shadow color) plus inner White/12 highlight (0/3/3), i.e. Component_effect/primary_default's box-shadow layers, flat in onmars v2. Its backdrop blur is not applied: a 4px dot has nothing to blur (brief §5 perf note).
- `--ki-status-size`: dimension used by the status component for the dot: the MarsUI 4px dot, Space/xs bound to every Status variant (specs/021-ki-status/design-extraction.md). One size per theme, never an attribute (FR-006).
- `--ki-status-success-color`: color used by the status component for the success tone fill: Surface/success_med_em, the exact variable bound to the Type=success Status variant (Success/500).
- `--ki-status-warning-color`: color used by the status component for the warning tone fill: Text/warning_high_em (Warning/800 light, Warning/300 dark) — a declared a11y deviation from the MarsUI binding Surface/warning_med_em (Warning/500), which reads 1.92:1 on the light page. No warning surface step clears the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 asks of the dot (Warning/600 reads 2.33:1), so the fill takes the warning ink that is legible on the page (FR-008).
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-step

One authored step in a Stepper.

When to use: Place directly inside ki-stepper in task order. Its default slot
is the step label and its properties describe the step to the owning list.
When NOT to use: Standalone or with interactive content in the label.
A completed step can make the label itself a link.

Examples:

# Step examples

Place each step directly inside a `ki-stepper`. Use plain text or passive
inline markup for the label and `description` for supporting text.

```html
<ki-stepper label="Checkout progress" orientation="vertical">
  <ki-step state="done" href="/checkout/address">Address</ki-step>
  <ki-step state="current" description="Confirm the billing address.">Billing</ki-step>
  <ki-step>Review</ki-step>
</ki-stepper>
```

Attributes:
- `description` (string | undefined): Optional supporting text displayed below the label.
- `href` (string | undefined, URL): Destination for a completed step. Omit for a passive step.
- `state` ("current" | "done" | "error" | "upcoming", default 'upcoming'): The step's progress state. Mark the active step as current.

Slots:
- (default): The visible label. Use text or passive inline markup.

Parts: none

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-stepper

An ordered, responsive view of progress through named steps.

When to use: Show the current place in onboarding, checkout or a wizard.
Provide a label and direct ki-step children in task order.
When NOT to use: A percentage or indeterminate task, a carousel position,
or navigation among peer views. The task owner updates step states.

Examples:

# Stepper examples

## Setup wizard

```html
<ki-stepper label="Setup progress">
  <ki-step state="done" href="/setup/account">Account</ki-step>
  <ki-step state="done">Workspace</ki-step>
  <ki-step state="current">Invite team</ki-step>
  <ki-step>Review</ki-step>
</ki-stepper>
```

At under 22rem of available inline size, the horizontal stepper shows
**Step 3 of 4**. Activate the summary to open the ordered list and return
to the Account step.

## Vertical setup guide

```html
<ki-stepper label="Publish a surface" orientation="vertical">
  <ki-step state="done">Connect the repository</ki-step>
  <ki-step state="current">Choose a theme</ki-step>
  <ki-step state="error" description="Check the repository permissions.">Run checks</ki-step>
  <ki-step description="Publish when the checks pass.">Publish</ki-step>
</ki-stepper>
```

## Localized status and summary

```html
<ki-stepper
  label="Avance de la configuración"
  done-label="Completado"
  current-label="Actual"
  upcoming-label="Sin empezar"
  error-label="Error"
  summary-label="Paso {current} de {total}"
  count-label="Pasos ({total})"
>
  <ki-step state="done">Cuenta</ki-step>
  <ki-step state="current">Equipo</ki-step>
  <ki-step>Revisión</ki-step>
</ki-stepper>
```

Attributes:
- `count-label` (string | undefined, default 'Steps ({total})'): Compact disclosure text without a current step. Include {total}.
- `current-label` (string | undefined, default 'Current'): Localized text for the current step.
- `done-label` (string | undefined, default 'Completed'): Localized text for a completed step.
- `error-label` (string | undefined, default 'Error'): Localized text for a step that has an error.
- `label` (string, required): Accessible name of the list. Use a localized description of the task.
- `orientation` ("horizontal" | "vertical", default 'horizontal'): Use vertical for a stacked list. Horizontal layout compacts below 22rem.
- `summary-label` (string | undefined, default 'Step {current} of {total}'): Compact disclosure text. Place {current} and {total} in the local order.
- `upcoming-label` (string | undefined, default 'Not started'): Localized text for an upcoming step.

Slots:
- (default): Direct ki-step children in task order. The stepper assigns each child to its row automatically.

Parts:
- `connector`: The decorative line leading to the next step.
- `description`: Optional supporting text below the label.
- `list`: The ordered list.
- `marker`: The decorative step number or state glyph.
- `step`: A list item in the sequence.
- `summary`: The compact disclosure button.
- `title`: The label, rendered as a link when a completed step has a destination.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-corner-activity-mark`: Round corners for rings and typing dots.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-7xl`: The 7xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-md`: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-sm`: The sm spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xl`: The xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xs`: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-layout-spacing-xxs`: The xxs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.
- `--ki-step-description-bg`: Backing of a step description.
- `--ki-step-description-fg`: Ink of a step description.
- `--ki-stepper-connector`: Decorative connector from a step that is still incomplete.
- `--ki-stepper-connector-done`: Decorative connector from a completed step.
- `--ki-stepper-current-bg`: Fill of the current step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-current-border`: Outline of the current step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-current-fg`: Number ink on the current step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-done-bg`: Fill of a completed step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-done-fg`: Glyph ink on the completed step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-dot-size`: Diameter of the step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-error-bg`: Fill of the step error marker.
- `--ki-stepper-error-border`: Outline of the step error marker.
- `--ki-stepper-error-fg`: Glyph ink of the step error marker.
- `--ki-stepper-glyph-size`: Size of the marker and disclosure glyphs.
- `--ki-stepper-label-bg`: Default backing of a step label.
- `--ki-stepper-label-fg`: Default ink of a step label.
- `--ki-stepper-stroke`: Width of the marker outline and connector.
- `--ki-stepper-summary-bg`: Backing of the compact disclosure.
- `--ki-stepper-summary-fg`: Ink of the compact disclosure.
- `--ki-stepper-upcoming-bg`: Fill of an upcoming step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-upcoming-border`: Outline of an upcoming step marker.
- `--ki-stepper-upcoming-fg`: Number and label ink of an upcoming step.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold`: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

### ki-suggestion

A native prompt button displayed by a ki-suggestions group.

When to use: offer one short, actionable prompt in a suggestion group.
When NOT to use: navigation, static content, or a submitted form value.

Examples:

# ki-suggestion examples

## Add context to a prompt

```html
<ki-suggestions label="Start a conversation" variant="cards">
  <ki-suggestion description="For the merged pull requests">Draft release notes</ki-suggestion>
  <ki-suggestion>Plan the next release</ki-suggestion>
</ki-suggestions>
```

Put the prompt in the default slot as plain text. The title supplies the
button's accessible name. Use `description` for separate context.

Register both tags for direct imports. Listen to `ki-select` on the group
for the chosen title.

Attributes:
- `description` (string | undefined): Optional accessible description, visible below the title in cards.

Slots:
- (default): Plain text forming the visible and accessible prompt title.

Parts:
- `button`: The native suggestion button.
- `description`: Optional supporting text shown in cards.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-focus-ring-color`: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.
- `--ki-focus-ring-offset`: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.
- `--ki-focus-ring-width`: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.
- `--ki-suggestion-backdrop-filter`: Filter behind the chip surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-bg`: Resting chip surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-bg-image`: Image layered over the chip surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-border`: Resting chip boundary.
- `--ki-suggestion-border-width`: Boundary width for either suggestion variant.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-description-fg`: Resting card description.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-gap`: Space between the card title and description.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-hover-description-fg`: Description over the card hover surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-pressed-description-fg`: Description over the pressed card surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-description-line-height`: Line height of the card description.
- `--ki-suggestion-description-size`: Type size of the card description.
- `--ki-suggestion-fg`: Resting chip title.
- `--ki-suggestion-font-family`: Typeface of the suggestion text.
- `--ki-suggestion-font-size`: Type size of the prompt title.
- `--ki-suggestion-height`: Minimum painted height of a chip.
- `--ki-suggestion-hover-bg`: Chip surface on a hovering device.
- `--ki-suggestion-hover-fg`: Title over the chip hover surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-inset`: Inline padding for either variant.
- `--ki-suggestion-line-height`: Line height of the prompt title.
- `--ki-suggestion-pressed-bg`: Chip surface while a pointer or key holds activation.
- `--ki-suggestion-pressed-fg`: Title over the pressed chip surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-radius`: Rounded outline of a chip.
- `--ki-suggestion-weight`: Weight of chip titles and card descriptions.

### ki-suggestions

A labelled group of prompt starters or follow-up suggestions.

When to use: offer suggested prompts to start or continue an assistant conversation.
When NOT to use: choose a form value, switch views, or display static example text.

Examples:

# ki-suggestions examples

## Fill a draft for editing

```html
<ki-suggestions id="starters" label="Start a conversation" variant="cards" mode="fill">
  <ki-suggestion description="For the merged pull requests">Draft release notes</ki-suggestion>
  <ki-suggestion description="From the on-call reports">Summarise the incidents</ki-suggestion>
</ki-suggestions>
<label for="draft">Message</label>
<textarea id="draft"></textarea>
```

```js
import { defineCustomElement as defineSuggestions } from '@kimen/elements/ki-suggestions';
import { defineCustomElement as defineSuggestion } from '@kimen/elements/ki-suggestion';

defineSuggestions();
defineSuggestion();

document.querySelector('#starters').composer = document.querySelector('#draft');
```

The group replaces the draft and focuses the textarea. A custom composer can
expose the same writable string `value` and `focus()` interface.

## Send a follow-up

```html
<ki-suggestions id="follow-ups" label="Follow-up suggestions">
  <ki-suggestion>Which ones recur?</ki-suggestion>
  <ki-suggestion>Group them by service</ki-suggestion>
</ki-suggestions>
```

```js
const followUps = document.querySelector('#follow-ups');
followUps.composer = document.querySelector('#draft');
followUps.addEventListener('ki-select', ({ detail }) => {
  sendPrompt(detail.text);
});
```

Here `sendPrompt` is the application's conversation handler. After dispatch,
the group focuses the composer and preserves its draft. Cancel the event to
manage value and focus in the application handler.

Attributes:
- `label` (string, required): Required accessible name for the group.
- `mode` ("fill" | "send", default 'send'): Send through the application or fill its attached editor for revision.
- `variant` ("cards" | "chips", default 'chips'): Wrapping chips for follow-ups or cards with room for a description.

Slots:
- (default): Direct ki-suggestion children in reading order.

Parts:
- `group`: The container that lays out the suggested prompts.

Events:
- `ki-select` (CustomEvent<{ text: string }>): Reports the chosen prompt title. Use this event to send the prompt in send mode. Cancel it to take over the default composer write and focus.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-suggestion-card-backdrop-filter`: Filter behind the card surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-bg`: Resting card surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-bg-image`: Image layered over the card surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-border`: Resting card boundary.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-fg`: Resting card title.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-hover-bg`: Card surface on a hovering device.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-hover-fg`: Title over the card hover surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-inset`: Block padding of each starter card.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-pressed-bg`: Card surface while a pointer or key holds activation.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-pressed-fg`: Title over the pressed card surface.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-radius`: Corners of a starter card.
- `--ki-suggestion-card-weight`: Weight of the card title.
- `--ki-suggestions-card-width`: Maximum inline size of each starter card.
- `--ki-suggestions-font-family`: Typeface inherited by the suggestion group.
- `--ki-suggestions-gap`: Spacing between suggestions.

### ki-switch

A token-styled switch for immediate on/off settings. Like a native field, it answers `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()`, `setCustomValidity(message)`, `validity`, `validationMessage` and `willValidate` synchronously, on the custom-elements build (not on hosts created by the lazy loader).

When to use: binary settings whose change takes effect immediately, always
with a slotted label.
When NOT to use: selections collected for later form submission; use
ki-checkbox for recorded choices, ki-radio-group for mutually exclusive
choices, and ki-button for actions.

Examples:

The slotted label is the accessible name source, and boolean presence semantics apply to `checked` — any present attribute means on, omit it for off:

```html
<ki-switch checked>Autosave</ki-switch>
<ki-switch>Desktop notifications</ki-switch>
```

While on, a named switch contributes `name`/`value` to native form data (`on` when `value` is omitted, checkbox parity); while off it contributes nothing:

```html
<form>
  <ki-switch name="tracking" value="enabled" checked>Usage analytics</ki-switch>
</form>
```

User toggles dispatch composed `input` and `change` events — apply the setting immediately, a switch never waits for a submit; `disabled` preserves the current state while removing the switch from keyboard reach and form data:

```html
<ki-switch checked disabled>Beta features (unavailable on this plan)</ki-switch>
```

## An error from the application

Set `custom-error` to show the application's verdict on a setting it could
not apply. The switch is invalid, blocks its form and is announced as
invalid at once. Toggling it withdraws the error. Remove the attribute when
a new attempt starts: setting the same text again while it is still set
shows nothing.

```html
<ki-switch name="two-step" checked custom-error="Add a phone number before turning on two-step sign-in.">Two-step sign-in</ki-switch>
```

Attributes:
- `checked` (boolean, default false): Live on/off state. Boolean presence semantics apply: any present `checked` attribute value, including `checked="false"` or malformed agent output, means on. Omit the attribute to express off. When to use: set the initial on state for a setting that applies immediately. When NOT to use: do not use a switch for choices saved only on submit; use ki-checkbox for that pattern.
- `custom-error` (string | undefined): An error of the application's own, such as a server-side verdict on the submitted setting ("Two-step sign-in needs a phone number"). While it holds text the switch is invalid, blocks its form, shows the text in place of the help text at once and is announced as invalid. It stops counting when the person toggles the switch, or when the form is reset, so it never blocks the corrected answer. It outranks an error set with `setCustomValidity`. When to use: report a verdict from a declarative spec, a live update or a framework binding. Remove it when a new attempt starts. When NOT to use: do not use it for help that is not an error; use `help-text`. Setting the same text again while the prop still holds it shows nothing: remove it first, then set it again.
- `disabled` (boolean, default false): Prevents toggling, removes the switch from keyboard reach, excludes it from form data, and exposes the unavailable state to assistive technology. When to use: make a setting temporarily unavailable while preserving its current state. When NOT to use: do not use disabled for pending or loading states.
- `help-text` (string | undefined): One line of help under the switch, read with it as its description: what turning it on changes. When NOT to use: do not repeat the label. A switch has no constraint of its own, so it takes no error text; an error the application sets with `custom-error` or `setCustomValidity` shows in this line's place.
- `name` (string | undefined): Form-data key contributed while the switch is on. When to use: include the immediate setting in native form data when on. When NOT to use: omit when no form entry should be submitted.
- `size` ("lg" | "md" | "sm" | "xl", default 'md'): Token-backed size: the track is 32 x 18, 40 x 22, 48 x 26 or 56 x 32px in onmars (`xl` is the design's mobile size), with its thumb. `sm` also takes the smaller label (13/20, 8px away). An unrecognized value matches no style rule and keeps the medium metrics. When to use: match the size of the text and controls around it. When NOT to use: do not pick a smaller size to fit a dense region or a larger one for touch; declare `data-ki-density` on the region instead, which composes with every size.
- `value` (string | undefined): Form-data value submitted while on. Omit for native checkbox parity: the submitted value defaults to `on`. When to use: submit a domain-specific value instead of the default `on`. When NOT to use: do not set a value to represent off; off contributes nothing.

Slots:
- (default): Label content. This is the accessible name source.

Parts:
- `error`: Line that shows, in place of the help text, an error the application set with `setCustomValidity` once the form is submitted; a polite live region, starting with a decorative error symbol.
- `help`: Help line under the switch, read as its description.
- `label`: Label wrapper around the default slot.
- `thumb`: Traveling handle.
- `track`: On/off channel.

Events:
- `change` (Event): Fired once after a user toggle commits, composed across the shadow boundary; `checked` is already current when listeners run. `click()` from a script, or a page `<label>` for the switch, toggles it like a native checkbox: one `input`, then one `change`. When to use: apply the on/off effect. When NOT to use: do not expect it for programmatic `checked` writes, which are silent.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-motion-easing-standard`: Standard interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-switch-border-width`: dimension used by the switch component for border width (MarsUI tracks are borderless; the 1px hairline in ki.outline.control is the declared WCAG 1.4.11 deviation at half the former weight, so the control stops reading as an outlined pill).
- `--ki-switch-checked-active-border`: color used by the switch component for checked active border.
- `--ki-switch-checked-active-thumb`: color used by the switch component for checked active thumb.
- `--ki-switch-checked-active-track`: color used by the switch component for checked active track.
- `--ki-switch-checked-disabled-border`: color used by the switch component for checked disabled border.
- `--ki-switch-checked-disabled-thumb`: color used by the switch component for checked disabled thumb (MarsUI pointer keeps its light construction in every state including disabled).
- `--ki-switch-checked-disabled-track`: color used by the switch component for checked disabled track (MarsUI disabled track keeps the OFF rest fill surface/disabled_med_em; the disabled signal lives in the glyph in the master).
- `--ki-switch-checked-hover-border`: color used by the switch component for checked hover border.
- `--ki-switch-checked-hover-thumb`: color used by the switch component for checked hover thumb.
- `--ki-switch-checked-hover-track`: color used by the switch component for checked hover track.
- `--ki-switch-checked-rest-border`: color used by the switch component for checked rest border.
- `--ki-switch-checked-rest-thumb`: color used by the switch component for checked rest thumb.
- `--ki-switch-checked-rest-track`: color used by the switch component for checked rest track.
- `--ki-switch-control-height`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint height at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes. The well pads the track by half of (control-height - track-height) on every side.
- `--ki-switch-control-width`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint width at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes. The well is centred in it; set it to the track width, with control-height, to drop the well.
- `--ki-switch-focus-ring-color`: color used by the switch component for focus ring color.
- `--ki-switch-focus-ring-offset`: dimension used by the switch component for focus ring offset.
- `--ki-switch-focus-ring-shadow`: shadow used by the switch component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
- `--ki-switch-focus-ring-width`: dimension used by the switch component for focus ring width.
- `--ki-switch-gap`: dimension used by the switch component for the gap between the control and its label at sizes md, lg and xl; sm-gap sets sm.
- `--ki-switch-glyph-checked`: Color of the enabled checked switch's thumb check. Use transparent to hide it. When visible, maintain 3:1 contrast with the thumb.
- `--ki-switch-glyph-dash-height`: dimension used by the switch component for the disabled dash glyph block size (Figma pointer exports: 8x2 rounded dash).
- `--ki-switch-glyph-disabled`: Color of the thumb check or dash on a disabled switch. Use transparent to hide both disabled glyphs.
- `--ki-switch-glyph-height`: dimension used by the switch component for the thumb state glyph block size (Figma pointer exports: 4px check ink height).
- `--ki-switch-glyph-unchecked`: Color of the enabled unchecked switch's thumb dash. Transparent hides it by default. When visible, maintain 3:1 contrast with the thumb.
- `--ki-switch-glyph-width`: dimension used by the switch component for the thumb state glyph inline size (Figma pointer exports: 8px check/dash ink box inside the thumb).
- `--ki-switch-lg-control-height`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint height at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-control-width`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint width at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-min-target`: dimension used by the switch component for min target at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-thumb-inset`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inset at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-thumb-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb radius at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-thumb-size`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb block size at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-thumb-width`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inline size at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-track-height`: dimension used by the switch component for track height at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-track-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for track radius at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-track-width`: dimension used by the switch component for track width at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-lg-well-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for the well radius at size lg.
- `--ki-switch-min-target`: dimension used by the switch component for min target at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-sm-control-height`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint height at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-control-width`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint width at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-gap`: dimension used by the switch component for the gap between the control and its label at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-label-font-size`: dimension used by the switch component for the label font size at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-label-line-height`: dimension used by the switch component for the label line height at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-min-target`: dimension used by the switch component for min target at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-thumb-inset`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inset at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-thumb-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb radius at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-thumb-size`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb block size at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-thumb-width`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inline size at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-track-height`: dimension used by the switch component for track height at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-track-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for track radius at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-track-width`: dimension used by the switch component for track width at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-sm-well-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for the well radius at size sm.
- `--ki-switch-thumb-inset`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inset at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-thumb-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb radius at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-thumb-shadow`: shadow used by the switch component for the thumb in every state and size. Set it to none to drop the shadow.
- `--ki-switch-thumb-size`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb block size at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-thumb-width`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inline size at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-track-height`: dimension used by the switch component for track height at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-track-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for track radius at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-track-width`: dimension used by the switch component for track width at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-active-border`: color used by the switch component for unchecked active border.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-active-thumb`: color used by the switch component for unchecked active thumb.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-active-track`: color used by the switch component for unchecked active track (one step beyond hover; the master defines no pressed variant).
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-disabled-border`: color used by the switch component for unchecked disabled border.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-disabled-thumb`: color used by the switch component for unchecked disabled thumb (MarsUI pointer keeps its light construction in every state including disabled).
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-disabled-track`: color used by the switch component for unchecked disabled track (MarsUI disabled track keeps the OFF rest fill surface/disabled_med_em; the disabled signal lives in the glyph in the master).
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-hover-border`: color used by the switch component for unchecked hover border.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-hover-thumb`: color used by the switch component for unchecked hover thumb.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-hover-track`: color used by the switch component for unchecked hover track (Kimen-invented one-step ramp over the corrected rest fill; the master defines no hover variant).
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-rest-border`: color used by the switch component for unchecked rest border.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-rest-thumb`: color used by the switch component for unchecked rest thumb.
- `--ki-switch-unchecked-rest-track`: color used by the switch component for unchecked rest track (MarsUI OFF track = surface/disabled_med_em #dddfe4 light / White-18 dark — a solid soft fill, not an outlined pill).
- `--ki-switch-well-bg-end`: color used by the switch component for the bottom of the well gradient, at every size.
- `--ki-switch-well-bg-start`: color used by the switch component for the top of the well gradient, at every size. Transparent drops the well.
- `--ki-switch-well-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for the radius of the well that holds the track at the default md size (unprefixed); sm-, lg- and xl- tokens set the other sizes.
- `--ki-switch-xl-control-height`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint height at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-control-width`: dimension used by the switch component for the control footprint width at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-min-target`: dimension used by the switch component for min target at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-thumb-inset`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inset at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-thumb-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb radius at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-thumb-size`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb block size at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-thumb-width`: dimension used by the switch component for thumb inline size at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-track-height`: dimension used by the switch component for track height at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-track-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for track radius at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-track-width`: dimension used by the switch component for track width at size xl.
- `--ki-switch-xl-well-radius`: dimension used by the switch component for the well radius at size xl.
- `--ki-text-danger-high-em`: semantic color for text danger high em.
- `--ki-text-high-em`: semantic color for text high em.
- `--ki-text-supporting`: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 2.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-2`: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-normal`: semantic font weight for typography weight body normal.

### ki-tab

One selectable tab inside a `ki-tabs` view switcher.

When to use: label one peer content view inside `ki-tabs`, with optional
decorative `icon` and `start` or `end` slot media.
When NOT to use: standalone, for form value
selection, or for page navigation; use the parent group's `value` instead
of authoring `selected`.

Examples:

A tab's default slot is its label and accessible name source; `value` pairs it with the `ki-tab-panel` sharing the same value inside a `ki-tabs` group:

```html
<ki-tabs label="Settings" value="profile">
  <ki-tab value="profile">Profile</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab value="privacy">Privacy</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="profile">Profile settings</ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="privacy">Privacy settings</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

The `start` and `end` slots hold leading and trailing icons or media (they follow writing direction); keep decorative media `aria-hidden`:

```html
<ki-tabs label="Inbox views" value="all">
  <ki-tab value="all">
    <span slot="start" aria-hidden="true">✉</span>
    All mail
  </ki-tab>
  <ki-tab value="unread">Unread</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="all">Every conversation.</ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="unread">Unread conversations only.</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

`disabled` excludes the tab from selection by every modality, and `selected` is output-only state written by the group — set the group's `value` instead of authoring it:

```html
<ki-tabs label="Repository" value="commits">
  <ki-tab value="commits">Commits</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab value="releases" disabled>Releases</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="commits">Commit history</ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="releases">Published releases</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

For a decorative SVG, use the `icon` slot and give the tab a visible text
label in the default slot. The label names the tab and its linked panel.
The group's `icon-layout` controls whether the icon is above the label or
inline with it.

Attributes:
- `disabled` (boolean, default false): Prevents selection by every modality and exposes the unavailable state. Boolean presence semantics apply: `disabled="false"` is still disabled.
- `selected` (boolean, default false): Output-only selected state written by `ki-tabs`. Set the group's `value` to choose an initial tab; author-set `selected` is overwritten.
- `value` (string, default ''): Pairing identifier shared with a `ki-tab-panel`. The first tab with a value owns it; later duplicates render but are not selectable.

Slots:
- (default): Required visible text label and accessible name source.
- `end`: Trailing icon or media. Follows writing direction.
- `icon`: Decorative SVG. Supply visible text in the default slot.
- `start`: Leading icon or media. Follows writing direction.

Parts:
- `indicator`: Decorative selected-tab marker.
- `tab`: Tab surface.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-motion-distance-xs`: Motion travel distance xs (2px): hover-lift offsets.
- `--ki-motion-duration-fast`: Fast interaction transition duration.
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-motion-easing-standard`: Standard interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-tab-backdrop-filter`: Complete backdrop filter for a tab surface.
- `--ki-tab-bg-image`: Optional surface image for a tab.
- `--ki-tab-focus-ring-color`: color used by the tab component for focus ring color.
- `--ki-tab-focus-ring-offset`: dimension used by the tab component for focus ring offset.
- `--ki-tab-focus-ring-shadow`: shadow used by the tab component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
- `--ki-tab-focus-ring-width`: dimension used by the tab component for focus ring width.
- `--ki-tab-font-size`: dimension used by the tab component for font size.
- `--ki-tab-font-weight`: font weight used by the tab component for font weight.
- `--ki-tab-gap`: dimension used by the tab component for gap.
- `--ki-tab-icon-inline-gap`: Gap from an inline tab icon to its label.
- `--ki-tab-icon-size`: Inline and block size of a decorative tab icon.
- `--ki-tab-indicator-color`: color used by the tab component for indicator color (MarsUI active underline is Outline/inverse_white: black in light, white in dark — the inverse neutral, not primary).
- `--ki-tab-indicator-radius`: dimension used by the tab component for indicator radius (the master underline is a square-ended 2px bottom border).
- `--ki-tab-indicator-size`: dimension used by the tab component for indicator size.
- `--ki-tab-line-height`: dimension used by the tab component for line height.
- `--ki-tab-min-block-size`: dimension used by the tab component for min block size (MarsUI Tab_nav md bar height 40px: 24px body_1 label + 8px block-end clearance + underline; retargeted from ki.space.7xl per the fidelity audit — material3 pins its own value).
- `--ki-tab-padding-block-end`: dimension used by the tab component for padding block end (MarsUI Tab_nav_item: 8px inset keeping the 2px underline clear of the 13/24 label; formalizes the fallback ki-tab.css already consumes).
- `--ki-tab-padding-inline`: dimension used by the tab component for padding inline (MarsUI items carry no inline padding: spacing comes from the bar gap and the underline spans the full item width).
- `--ki-tab-radius`: dimension used by the tab component for radius.
- `--ki-tab-selected-active-bg`: color used by the tab component for selected active background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).
- `--ki-tab-selected-active-fg`: color used by the tab component for selected active foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never the accent; master 10048:1240).
- `--ki-tab-selected-disabled-bg`: color used by the tab component for selected disabled background (no disabled variant exists in Tab_nav; disabled must be quieter than rest, not a filled pill).
- `--ki-tab-selected-disabled-fg`: color used by the tab component for selected disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder: Gray/500 light / White-32 dark, the value ki-status and ki-switch already use for disabled glyphs).
- `--ki-tab-selected-hover-bg`: color used by the tab component for selected hover background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).
- `--ki-tab-selected-hover-fg`: color used by the tab component for selected hover foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never the accent; master 10048:1240).
- `--ki-tab-selected-rest-bg`: color used by the tab component for selected rest background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state; background pills are Switcher language).
- `--ki-tab-selected-rest-fg`: color used by the tab component for selected rest foreground (MarsUI active tab label is neutral Text/high_em — never the accent; master 10048:1240).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-active-bg`: color used by the tab component for unselected active background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-active-fg`: color used by the tab component for unselected active foreground (mirrors hover; MarsUI defines no pressed variant).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-disabled-bg`: color used by the tab component for unselected disabled background (no disabled variant exists in Tab_nav; disabled must be quieter than rest, not a filled pill).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-disabled-fg`: color used by the tab component for unselected disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder: Gray/500 light / White-32 dark, the value ki-status and ki-switch already use for disabled glyphs).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-hover-bg`: color used by the tab component for unselected hover background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-hover-fg`: color used by the tab component for unselected hover foreground (with rest at med_em, hover darkens one em step, preserving the master rest-to-hover direction).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-rest-bg`: color used by the tab component for unselected rest background (MarsUI Tab_nav is transparent_inverse in every state).
- `--ki-tab-unselected-rest-fg`: color used by the tab component for unselected rest foreground (Figma inactive is Text/low_em, which fails the 4.5:1 text gate at 13px; med_em is the gate-compliant rest value — declared deviation).
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-tab-panel

One content view paired with a `ki-tab` inside `ki-tabs`.

When to use: hold the content for one peer tab view, sharing `value` with
its `ki-tab`.
When NOT to use: standalone, as lazy mounting, or for page
navigation; orphan and duplicate panels are hidden by the parent group.

Examples:

A panel is visible only while the `ki-tab` sharing its `value` is selected; the default slot holds the content:

```html
<ki-tabs label="Documentation" value="guide">
  <ki-tab value="guide">Guide</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab value="reference">Reference</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="guide">Step-by-step instructions.</ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="reference">Complete API tables.</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

Panels hold arbitrary content, form controls included; every panel mounts eagerly (no lazy mounting exists):

```html
<ki-tabs label="Account" value="contact">
  <ki-tab value="contact">Contact</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab value="password">Password</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="contact">
    <ki-input label="Work email" name="email" type="email"></ki-input>
  </ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="password">Password change form.</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

The first panel with a given `value` owns it — duplicate or orphan panels stay hidden without error:

```html
<ki-tabs label="Report" value="summary">
  <ki-tab value="summary">Summary</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="summary">Quarterly totals.</ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="detail">Never shown: no tab shares this value.</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

Attributes:
- `value` (string, default ''): Pairing identifier shared with a `ki-tab`. The first panel with a value owns it; duplicate or orphan panels stay hidden.

Slots:
- (default): Panel content.

Parts:
- `panel`: Panel surface.

Events: none

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-space-scale`: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).
- `--ki-motion-distance-sm`: Motion travel distance sm (4px): small slide/settle offsets.
- `--ki-motion-duration-medium-1`: M3 md.sys.motion.duration.medium1 (250ms). onmars: MarsUI moderate step (240ms, 2x the 120ms base).
- `--ki-motion-easing-out`: Decelerating interaction transition easing curve.
- `--ki-tab-panel-bg`: color used by the tab panel component for background (Tab_nav masters have no panel chrome: content sits on the ambient surface; the panel never paints a surface it does not own).
- `--ki-tab-panel-fg`: color used by the tab panel component for foreground (pairs a scheme-correct text color with whatever ground the transparent panel sits on — fixes black-on-black slotted text in dark).
- `--ki-tab-panel-focus-ring-color`: color used by the tab panel component for focus ring color.
- `--ki-tab-panel-focus-ring-offset`: dimension used by the tab panel component for focus ring offset.
- `--ki-tab-panel-focus-ring-width`: dimension used by the tab panel component for focus ring width.
- `--ki-tab-panel-padding-block`: dimension used by the tab panel component for padding block.
- `--ki-tab-panel-padding-inline`: dimension used by the tab panel component for padding inline.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-table

A scrollable frame for a native data table with optional sorting and selection.

When to use: Show records with shared fields that people compare, scan or sort.
Supply a native caption, column headers with scope="col" and record headers
with scope="row". Mark numeric cells with data-numeric and secondary cells
with data-meta. The host application supplies the native table markup.
When NOT to use: Lay out a screen, show a short one-line list, or present the
name-value details of one record. Use CSS grid, ki-list or a description list.

Examples:

# Table examples

Wrap one native table and keep the caption, column scope and row scope in
the markup. A selected row's `data-key` identifies its record after sorting
or replacement.

```html
<ki-table id="services" selectable sticky-header style="max-block-size: 14rem">
  <table>
    <caption>Services</caption>
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th scope="col" data-sort="name" aria-sort="ascending">Name</th>
        <th scope="col">Status</th>
        <th scope="col" data-numeric>Runs</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr data-key="billing">
        <th scope="row">Billing API</th>
        <td><ki-badge size="sm" tone="success">Ready</ki-badge></td>
        <td data-numeric>64</td>
      </tr>
      <tr data-key="search">
        <th scope="row">Search index</th>
        <td><ki-badge size="sm" tone="warning">Slow</ki-badge></td>
        <td data-numeric>18</td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</ki-table>
```

With individual imports or a framework wrapper, register `ki-checkbox` when
using `selectable`. The full Kimen loader registers both elements.

```js
import { defineCustomElement as defineTable } from '@kimen/elements/ki-table';
import { defineCustomElement as defineCheckbox } from '@kimen/elements/ki-checkbox';

defineTable();
defineCheckbox();
```

Apply sort requests and update the native header state from the page.

```js
const frame = document.querySelector('#services');
const table = frame.querySelector('table');

frame.addEventListener('ki-sort', ({ detail: { key, direction } }) => {
  if (key !== 'name') return;
  const body = table.tBodies[0];
  const nameOf = (row) => row.querySelector('th[scope="row"]').textContent.trim();
  const sign = direction === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1;
  body.append(...Array.from(body.rows).sort((a, b) => sign * nameOf(a).localeCompare(nameOf(b))));

  for (const header of table.tHead.querySelectorAll('th[data-sort]')) {
    if (header.dataset.sort === key) header.setAttribute('aria-sort', direction);
    else header.removeAttribute('aria-sort');
  }
});

frame.addEventListener('ki-selection-change', ({ detail: { keys } }) => {
  updateBulkActions(keys);
});
```

Use `density="compact"` where the available block space is tight.
During a refresh, set `loading` to mark the native table busy and show
a placeholder below the existing records. Remove it once the refresh ends.

For a person column, place `<ki-avatar size="xs" initials="AG"></ki-avatar>`
next to the visible name. For a row menu, use a trailing "Actions" header
and a button whose name includes the row. Import
`@kimen/elements/icons/ellipsis` before mounting the glyph.

```html
<td>
  <ki-icon-button
    id="billing-actions"
    size="xs"
    variant="ghost"
    label="More actions for Billing API"
  >
    <ki-icon name="ellipsis"></ki-icon>
  </ki-icon-button>
  <ki-menu anchor="billing-actions">
    <ki-menu-item value="inspect">View service</ki-menu-item>
  </ki-menu>
</td>
```

Give each row trigger a unique ID and handle the menu's `ki-select` event in
the application. Translate the checkbox labels with `select-all-label="Sélectionner toutes les lignes"`
and `row-selection-label="Sélectionner {row}"` on a French page.

Attributes:
- `density` ("compact" | "default", default 'default'): Row density. Default measures 48px and compact measures 40px at a 16px root on desktop.
- `loading` (boolean, default false): Makes the native table busy and adds a decorative loading row after the current records.
- `row-selection-label` (string, default 'Select {row}'): Accessible name template for each row checkbox. Include {row} for the row header or key.
- `select-all-label` (string, default 'Select all rows'): Accessible name for the bulk selection checkbox. Translate for the page language.
- `selectable` (boolean, default false): Adds a leading selection column with a checked, mixed or unchecked bulk control. Give each selectable body row a distinct, nonempty data-key. Register ki-checkbox alongside ki-table when using individual component imports.
- `sticky-header` (boolean, default false): Keeps the native column header in view inside a vertically constrained frame.

Slots:
- (default): One native light-DOM table with a caption, head and body. Use data-sort on sortable headers and data-key on each record available for selection.

Parts: none

Events:
- `ki-selection-change` (CustomEvent<KiTableSelectionDetail>): A person changes selection with a checkbox. The event supplies the selected data-key values in displayed order.
- `ki-sort` (CustomEvent<KiTableSortDetail>): A person activates a sortable column. Use the key and direction to sort records and move aria-sort to the active header. The event is a request.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-density-control-offset`: Added to the block size of every scaled control and row (button, icon button, field, select, textarea, option, list item, tab). Components floor the result at ki.size.target-min.
- `--ki-density-target-min`: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).
- `--ki-table-backdrop-filter`: Complete filter applied behind the frame.
- `--ki-table-bg`: Table frame and caption surface.
- `--ki-table-bg-image`: Optional image layered over the table frame.
- `--ki-table-border`: Frame and row dividers.
- `--ki-table-border-width`: Frame and row divider stroke.
- `--ki-table-caption-font-family`: Typeface of the native table caption.
- `--ki-table-cell-padding-inline`: Horizontal space inside cells.
- `--ki-table-fg`: Primary record and caption ink.
- `--ki-table-focus-radius`: Corner radius of the sort button focus ring.
- `--ki-table-focus-ring-color`: Keyboard focus outline ink.
- `--ki-table-focus-ring-offset`: Space between a focus outline and its control.
- `--ki-table-focus-ring-width`: Keyboard focus outline stroke.
- `--ki-table-header-bg`: Column header surface, including when sticky.
- `--ki-table-header-bg-image`: Optional image layered over the column header.
- `--ki-table-header-fg`: Column header ink.
- `--ki-table-header-height`: Column header row height.
- `--ki-table-meta-fg`: Secondary and numeric value ink.
- `--ki-table-radius`: Outer frame corner radius.
- `--ki-table-row-height`: Default data row height.
- `--ki-table-row-height-compact`: Compact data row height.
- `--ki-table-row-hover-bg`: Surface under a record on hover.
- `--ki-table-row-hover-fg`: Record ink on hover.
- `--ki-table-row-selected-bg`: Surface under a selected record.
- `--ki-table-row-selected-fg`: Record ink when selected.
- `--ki-table-skeleton`: Decorative loading bar fill.
- `--ki-table-skeleton-height`: Loading bar height.
- `--ki-table-skeleton-radius`: Loading bar corner radius.
- `--ki-table-sort-gap`: Space between a column label and sort indicator.
- `--ki-table-sort-glyph-size`: Decorative sort indicator edge.
- `--ki-table-touch-target-min`: Minimum width and height of controls with a coarse pointer.
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.
- `--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-size-body-1`: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.
- `--ki-typography-size-caption-2`: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.
- `--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size`: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-medium`: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.
- `--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold`: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

### ki-tabs

A tab group for switching between peer content views.

When to use: switch between small sets of peer views inside the same page,
with one visible panel at a time. Use primary for the screen-level group
and secondary inside content.
When NOT to use: selecting form values
(use `ki-radio-group`), page navigation (use links), step flows, or
standalone `ki-tab` / `ki-tab-panel` children outside this group.

Examples:

Tabs pair with panels through a shared `value`; the group's `value` selects the active pair and `label` names the tablist:

```html
<ki-tabs label="Settings" value="email">
  <ki-tab value="email">Email</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab value="security">Security</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="email">Email delivery preferences</ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="security">Security and sign-in preferences</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

A disabled tab stays visible but cannot be selected by any modality; user selection dispatches a composed `ki-change` event carrying the new value in `detail.value` (programmatic `value` writes stay silent):

```html
<ki-tabs label="Billing" value="plans">
  <ki-tab value="plans">Plans</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab value="invoices" disabled>Invoices</ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="plans">Plan management</ki-tab-panel>
  <ki-tab-panel value="invoices">Invoice history</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

Use a primary group for tabs at screen level. In content, use
`variant="secondary"` for a full-width selection indicator. A decorative
SVG in a tab's `icon` slot stacks above the label in primary tabs and
appears before the label in secondary tabs. Set `icon-layout="inline"` or
`icon-layout="stacked"` to override the layout for the group.

```html
<ki-tabs label="Mail sections" variant="secondary">
  <ki-tab value="inbox">
    <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
      <path d="M3 5h18v14H3zM3 5l9 7 9-7" />
    </svg>
    Inbox
  </ki-tab>
  <ki-tab-panel value="inbox">Incoming messages</ki-tab-panel>
</ki-tabs>
```

Attributes:
- `icon-layout` ("inline" | "stacked" | undefined): Positions the decorative icon relative to its tab label. When omitted, primary stacks the icon above the label and secondary puts it inline.
- `label` (string | undefined): Accessible name for the tablist. Always provide one when multiple tab groups may appear in a view. When NOT to use: do not use `label` as a visible heading; render visible context in surrounding content.
- `size` ("lg" | "md" | "sm" | "xl" | "xs", default 'md'): Token-backed strip size: every `ki-tab` it holds is 24, 32, 40, 48 or 56px tall in onmars, with its text, and the gap between tabs follows. The strip decides for all its tabs; a tab has no size of its own. An unrecognized value matches no style rule and keeps the medium metrics. When to use: match the size of the controls around the strip. When NOT to use: do not pick a smaller size to fit a dense region or a larger one for touch; declare `data-ki-density` on the region instead, which composes with every size.
- `value` (string, default ''): Resolved selected value. The attribute declares the initial request; the live property falls back to the first enabled owner tab, or `""` when no tab is selectable. Programmatic writes are silent.
- `variant` ("primary" | "secondary" | undefined, default 'primary'): Visual treatment for the group. Use one primary group per screen and secondary groups within content.

Slots:
- (default): `ki-tab` and `ki-tab-panel` children. Tabs are auto-assigned to an internal named slot as managed output.

Parts:
- `tablist`: Internal row around the tab strip: gap, alignment and the divider. The strip inside it carries the `tablist` role.

Events:
- `ki-change` (CustomEvent<{ value: string }>): Fired once after a user-driven selection change from pointer or keyboard navigation. `detail.value` is the resolved selected value and `value` is already current when listeners run. Programmatic `value` writes and first-render fallback are silent.

Methods: none

CSS custom properties:
- `--ki-tab-icon-stacked-gap`: Gap from a stacked tab icon to its label.
- `--ki-tab-icon-stacked-min-block-size`: Minimum block size for a tab with a stacked icon.
- `--ki-tab-lg-font-size`: dimension used by the tab component for lg font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 lg: UI/body-2).
- `--ki-tab-lg-line-height`: dimension used by the tab component for lg line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 lg: UI/body-2).
- `--ki-tab-lg-min-block-size`: dimension used by the tab component for lg min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 lg: 48px).
- `--ki-tab-padding-block-end`: dimension used by the tab component for padding block end (MarsUI Tab_nav_item: 8px inset keeping the 2px underline clear of the 13/24 label; formalizes the fallback ki-tab.css already consumes).
- `--ki-tab-primary-indicator-height`: Height of the content-width indicator on a primary icon tab.
- `--ki-tab-secondary-indicator-height`: Height of the full-width indicator on a secondary tab.
- `--ki-tab-sm-font-size`: dimension used by the tab component for sm font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 sm: UI/para).
- `--ki-tab-sm-line-height`: dimension used by the tab component for sm line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 sm: UI/para).
- `--ki-tab-sm-min-block-size`: dimension used by the tab component for sm min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 sm: 32px).
- `--ki-tab-xl-font-size`: dimension used by the tab component for xl font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xl: UI/title-2).
- `--ki-tab-xl-line-height`: dimension used by the tab component for xl line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xl: UI/title-2).
- `--ki-tab-xl-min-block-size`: dimension used by the tab component for xl min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xl: 56px).
- `--ki-tab-xs-font-size`: dimension used by the tab component for xs font size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xs: UI/caption-2). Figma draws caption_1, 10px; caption_2, 12px, is the smallest text the library ships (spec 050 D7).
- `--ki-tab-xs-line-height`: dimension used by the tab component for xs line height (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xs: UI/caption-2).
- `--ki-tab-xs-min-block-size`: dimension used by the tab component for xs min block size (Tab-nav-item 10048:1068 xs: 24px).
- `--ki-tabs-divider-color`: color used by the tabs component for divider color.
- `--ki-tabs-divider-width`: dimension used by the tabs component for the tablist divider width (the Tab_nav bar has no stroke; the hook stays for consumers to opt back in — material3 keeps its hairline via its override).
- `--ki-tabs-gap`: dimension used by the tabs component for gap (MarsUI md bar item gap Space/8xl 26px; the gap carries all spacing now that items have zero inline padding).
- `--ki-tabs-lg-gap`: dimension used by the tabs component for the lg gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 lg binds Space/9xl, 28px).
- `--ki-tabs-secondary-selected-rest-bg`: Selected secondary tab background at rest.
- `--ki-tabs-secondary-selected-rest-fg`: Selected secondary tab label foreground at rest.
- `--ki-tabs-secondary-unselected-rest-bg`: Secondary tab background at rest.
- `--ki-tabs-secondary-unselected-rest-fg`: Secondary tab label foreground at rest.
- `--ki-tabs-sm-gap`: dimension used by the tabs component for the sm gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 sm binds Space/7xl, 24px).
- `--ki-tabs-xl-gap`: dimension used by the tabs component for the xl gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 xl binds Space/10xl, 32px).
- `--ki-tabs-xs-gap`: dimension used by the tabs component for the xs gap between tabs (Tab-nav 10048:1249 xs binds Space/5xl, 20px).
- `--ki-typography-family-body`: semantic font family for typography family body.

### ki-textarea

A token-styled multiline text field with native form semantics. Like a native field, it answers `checkValidity()`, `reportValidity()`, `setCustomValidity(message)`, `validity`, `validationMessage` and `willValidate` synchronously, on the custom-elements build (not on hosts created by the lazy loader).

When to use: free-form text longer than one line, such as comments,
descriptions, messages, delivery notes, or addresses when paired with a
matching `autocomplete` purpose.
When NOT to use: single-line values (`ki-input`), constrained choices,
rich or formatted text editing, or search boxes.

Agent note: initial text is declared through the `value` attribute; element
text content is ignored. Enter inserts a line break and never submits the
enclosing form, the inverse of `ki-input`.

Examples:

A labeled multiline field in a form (`label` is mandatory — the visible label and accessible name); `rows` sets the stable visible line count (default `2`, no auto-grow in v1):

```html
<form>
  <ki-textarea label="Comments" name="comments" rows="4"></ki-textarea>
  <ki-button variant="primary">Send</ki-button>
</form>
```

Initial text is declared through the `value` attribute — element text content is ignored — and Enter inserts a line break, never submitting the enclosing form:

```html
<ki-textarea label="Bio" name="bio" value="Web components enthusiast."></ki-textarea>
```

`required` blocks submission while empty, and an `autocomplete` purpose such as `street-address` exposes the entry's meaning to autofill:

```html
<ki-textarea
  label="Shipping address"
  name="address"
  rows="3"
  autocomplete="street-address"
  required
></ki-textarea>
```

Read-only and disabled are distinct states — `readonly` stays focusable, selectable, submitted and validation-exempt; `disabled` is none of those:

